description_en: Jewel-tone leaded panes, black leading, sunlit arcade.
description_zh: 宝石色镶嵌玻璃、铅条线、日光回廊。

description_en: Matte clay diorama, fingerprint texture, seaside promenade.
description_zh: 哑光黏土微缩、指纹质感、海边长堤。

description_en: Two-ink riso on cream paper, halftone and slight misregister.
description_zh: 双色孔版、乳色纸、网点与轻微套印偏移。

description_en: Satin stitch and French knots on warm linen.
description_zh: 缎纹针与法国结，暖色亚麻底。

description_en: Dusty pigment on charcoal paper, festival fireworks night.
description_zh: 炭纸粉彩、颗粒晕边、烟火夜空。

description_en: Fuzzy wool craft, rainy cafe window, steam and felt rain.
description_zh: 羊毛毡纤维、雨窗咖啡馆、杯热气。

description_en: Carved gouge marks, indigo and warm orange on cream.
description_zh: 刀痕清晰、靛青与暖橙、乳色纸。

description_en: Palette-knife ridges, buttery paint, sunlit studio.
description_zh: 刮刀厚涂、油彩肌理、阳光画室。

description_en: Caustic light patterns as the dominant look (underwater scene is just the motif).
description_zh: 以焦散光效为主导画风（水下只是题材）。

description_en: Painterly aurora color bands as the dominant look.
description_zh: 以极光色带厚涂为主导画风。

description_en: Prussian-blue chemical print, rooftop kite.
description_zh: 普鲁士蓝晒像、屋顶放风筝。

description_en: Soft faceted geometry, pastel park picnic.
description_zh: 柔和切面几何、公园野餐。

description_en: Clean anime with glossy material lighting and reflective glaze sheen as the look — pottery is the scene, not the style name.
description_zh: 干净二次元 + 釉面高光材质光感；陶器是场景，不是风格名。

description_en: Parchment scrapbook / naturalist-journal collage with pressed-leaf framing — specimens are motif, collage is the style.
description_zh: 羊皮纸手账式博物拼贴；标本是题材，拼贴才是画风。

description_en: Wax-resist cracks, indigo-gold dye, night market.
description_zh: 蜡裂纹、靛金染料、夜市灯笼。

description_en: Fashion illustration on a solid flat color field; ornate lace and gloves as motif, not the style name.
description_zh: 纯色平涂底上的时尚插画；蕾丝手套是题材，不是风格名。

description_en: Painterly impasto on pure black; high contrast with white, navy, one red accent.
description_zh: 纯黑底厚涂；高对比白与海军蓝，一点红点缀。

description_en: Pop-art Ben-Day, hot pink and electric green.
description_zh: 波普网点、亮粉与电绿。

description_en: 3D-like skin and material render; rainy rooftop daylight scene.
description_zh: 半写实皮肤与材质渲染；雨后屋顶日光场景。

description_en: Gloss skin and sparkle-iris anime rendering; close framing is composition, not the style name.
description_zh: 高光皮肤与星辉瞳的二次元渲染；特写是构图，不是风格名。

description_en: Bleeding pigments, paper tooth, yellow umbrella rain.
description_zh: 水色渗化、纸纹、黄伞雨中。

description_en: Limited palette, film grain, bus-window sunset.
description_zh: 限色赛璐珞、胶片颗粒、巴士暮色。

description_en: Heavy brush contours, flat graphic blocks, skate mural.
description_zh: 粗毛笔勾线、平涂色块、滑板涂鸦墙。

description_en: Dense cross-hatch and thick contour manga-ink print language.
description_zh: 密排交叉线与粗轮廓的漫画墨线语言。

description_en: Hard daylight painting language; kitchen interior is only the motif.
description_zh: 硬日光厚涂语言；厨房只是题材。

description_en: Ink-watercolor, white negative space, teal and crimson lace.
description_zh: 水墨淡彩、留白、青绿与绯红蕾丝。

description_en: Soft painterly fantasy rendering; golden field is motif.
description_zh: 柔光幻想厚涂；金草原野是题材。

description_en: Near-monochrome black-white-grey with vivid red as the only accent color.
description_zh: 近乎黑白灰，仅用鲜红作唯一强调色。

description_en: Electric-blue midnight cityscape paint from a high balcony.
description_zh: 电蓝午夜城市厚涂；高处阳台视角。

description_en: Graphic modern woodblock / ukiyo-e anime language.
description_zh: 现代浮世绘木版感二次元语言。

description_en: Indigo-versus-ember luminous glow painting.
description_zh: 靛紫对暖金的流光厚涂。

description_en: Turquoise-and-gold filigree illustration language.
description_zh: 青绿与金箔纹样插画语言。

description_en: Mustard-gold, black, cream; disc halo and blossoms.
description_zh: 芥金黑奶油限色、圆盘光环与梅花。

description_en: High-key ice-white and cyan wash with sparse negative space.
description_zh: 高调冰白与青的晕染；大量留白。

description_en: Chiaroscuro on a void black ground; crimson marks, black dress, white lace.
description_zh: 黑底明暗法；绯红纹、黑裙白蕾丝。

description_en: Teal-and-black spot / key lighting as the dominant look; stage is motif.
description_zh: 青绿与黑的聚光主光语言；舞台是题材。

description_en: Sci-fi particle FX rendering; rings are motif.
description_zh: 科幻粒子特效渲染；光环是题材。

description_en: Polished kawaii thick-paint: silver hair, dusty-rose cafe light.
description_zh: 干净甜美厚涂：银灰发、灰粉咖啡馆光。

description_en: Glass + water-caustic rendering language; tunnel architecture is motif.
description_zh: 玻璃与水焦散渲染语言；隧道建筑是题材。

description_en: Violet-magenta glitch, chromatic fringe, luminous wings.
description_zh: 紫洋红故障、色散边、发光翼。

description_en: Dark-romantic polished illustration; lace is motif.
description_zh: 暗浪漫精致插画；蕾丝是题材。

description_en: Cinematic motion paint with Dutch tilt and fire glow.
description_zh: 电影感动势厚涂；荷兰角与火光。

description_en: Cream-peach high-key soft paint; mint-teal hair, quiet smile.
description_zh: 奶油桃色高调柔光厚涂；薄荷绿发、安静笑。

description_en: Matte opaque gouache, wet-into-wet blooms, chalky edges and bristle pulls.
description_zh: 哑光不透明水粉，湿画渗化、粉质边缘与笔毫痕迹。

description_en: Layered silk-screen spot inks, mesh grain, transparent overlaps and slight misregister.
description_zh: 分层丝网专色、网纹颗粒、透明叠色与轻微套印偏移。

description_en: Fine hatched tempera strokes, luminous matte mineral pigment on panel tooth.
description_zh: 细密排线蛋彩、哑光矿物色、木板底齿感。

description_en: Floating-ink marbling transferred to paper; concentric sumi veins as the look.
description_zh: 水面浮墨转印；同心墨纹作为主导画风。

description_en: Velvety rocked-plate grain, burnished highlights, continuous-tone black to silver.
description_zh: 摇点铜版绒黑、刮亮高光、连续调银灰。

description_en: Fused beeswax pigment, ironed layers, wax bloom and scraped ridges.
description_zh: 热熔蜂蜡颜料、熨烫叠层、蜡霜与刮痕脊。

description_en: India-ink clay board, incised white lines, knife and wire-brush hatching.
description_zh: 墨底黏土刮板、刮出白线、刀痕与钢丝刷排线。

description_en: Fine silver stylus on gesso ground, pale metal lines, faint tarnish warmth.
description_zh: 银尖在石膏底上细线、浅金属灰、微暖氧化。

description_en: Rosin-dust acid bite, velvety granulated tone, warm ink on cream rag paper.
description_zh: 松香飞尘酸蚀、绒面颗粒调子、奶油棉纸暖墨。

description_en: Discrete complementary dots of pure pigment, optical mixture, no blended stroke.
description_zh: 互补纯色点子、光学混色、无涂抹笔触。

description_en: Copper-plate drypoint with rich burr, velvety warm-black ink, plate tone on rag paper.
description_zh: 铜版干刻、绒边毛刺线、暖黑墨与纸面版调。

description_en: Monochrome grey oil modeling; cool slate and warm umber-grey, no chroma.
description_zh: 灰色单色油画塑形；冷石板灰与暖褐灰，无彩度。

description_en: Smoke-soft transitions, veiled glazes, no hard contours; form dissolves into air.
description_zh: 烟雾般柔过渡、薄釉罩染、无硬轮廓；形体溶入空气。

description_en: One-off plate impression: solvent lifts, brayer ghosts, ink residue, paper grain.
description_zh: 一次性版面转印：溶剂提墨、滚筒残影、墨渍与纸纹。

description_en: Layered pigmented gum on watercolor paper; pictorialist brush-photo hybrid.
description_zh: 水彩纸上多层色素树胶；画意摄影式笔触与影像混合。

description_en: Buon fresco: mineral pigment soaked into wet lime plaster, powdery matte tooth, faint giornate seams.
description_zh: 湿壁画：矿物色渗入湿石灰泥，粉质哑光齿感，隐约分日接缝。

description_en: Layered colored plaster; dark underlayer revealed by scratched incised lines and gouge hatching.
description_zh: 多层色泥；刮穿表层露出底色，刀痕排线与刻槽。

description_en: Greasy crayon on limestone grain, tusche washes, warm-black ink on cream rag paper.
description_zh: 石灰石蜡笔颗粒、药墨晕、奶油棉纸暖黑墨。

description_en: Iron-oxide red chalk on laid paper, stump blend, paper tooth, white-chalk heightening.
description_zh: 氧化铁红粉笔、擦笔晕、纸纹齿感、白粉笔提亮。

description_en: Meticulous ink outlines, layered mineral-color fills on silk, even graded washes in closed contours.
description_zh: 细匀墨线、矿物色多层填染、绢本闭合轮廓内均匀渲染。

description_en: End-grain burin cuts: fine white lines and micro-stipple on dense black ink, cream rag impression.
description_zh: 木口雕刀白线与微点、密黑墨底、奶油棉纸压印。

description_en: Flat unmodulated color fields bound by thick dark cloisonné contours; enamel-like planes, no blend.
description_zh: 平涂色块由粗黑景泰蓝轮廓圈定；珐琅平面，无混色。

description_en: Even-weight clear-line outlines, flat local color, uniform light, no hatching or heavy shadow.
description_zh: 等粗清晰轮廓、平涂固有色、均匀光，无排线与重影。

description_en: Matte opaque milk-protein body color; chalky velvety layers, dry-brush scumble on primed board.
description_zh: 酪蛋白胶不透明哑光；粉质绒面层、底板上枯笔擦色。

description_en: Velvet carbon powder on prepared paper; stump blends, eraser lights, matte silver-grey midtones.
description_zh: 炭粉铺于底纸；擦笔晕、橡皮提亮、哑光银灰中间调。

description_en: Mineral iwa-enogu on washi, gold-leaf fields, fine sumi contour with opaque crushed-stone color.
description_zh: 岩彩敷于和纸、金箔底、细墨线与不透明矿物色填染。

description_en: Hand-cut stencil gouache plates, hard stencil rims, layered flat inks on cream paper.
description_zh: 手工镂版水粉套色、硬边色口、乳色纸上层叠平涂油墨。

description_en: Glass and stone tesserae with grout lines, faceted smalti chips, no painterly blend.
description_zh: 玻璃石片镶嵌、灰缝清晰、珐琅碎色块，无笔触混色。

description_en: Atomized spray gradients, soft overspray, no brushstrokes or lineart; velvety commercial airbrush.
description_zh: 雾化喷绘渐变、柔边过喷、无笔触与线稿；绒面商业喷绘。

description_en: Multi-block tone woodcut: cream, ochre, umber, black; carved gouge marks and block registration.
description_zh: 多版明暗木刻：乳白、赭石、褐与黑；刀痕与套版对位。

description_en: Collaged-plate print: cardboard, fabric, gesso inked onto rag paper; embossed plate-mark and uneven ink catch.
description_zh: 拼贴制版：卡纸、织物、石膏转印厚棉纸；凹凸版痕与不均着墨。

description_en: Boneless wash: no contour line; mineral color masses wet-into-wet on xuan, edges formed by pigment not ink.
description_zh: 没骨设色：无勾勒；矿物色块湿接宣纸，边缘由色而非线成形。

description_en: Alcohol dye markers on bleedproof paper: chisel-nib facets, blender blooms, streaky layered transparent ink.
description_zh: 酒精马克笔：凿形笔触、无色调和晕边、透明叠色条纹。

description_en: Wet-plate ambrotype/tintype: poured collodion, liquid blacks, chemical flow at edges, metallic antique sheen.
description_zh: 湿版火棉胶：玻璃或锡版药膜、流淌边痕、液态暗部与金属旧光。

description_en: Wood-burning: scorched pen lines in timber grain, sepia-to-charcoal burns, visible growth rings, no paint.
description_zh: 烙画：电烙笔焦痕入木纹，褐至炭黑烧色，年轮可见，无颜料。

description_en: Hard-ground copper-plate etching: acid-bitten lines, dense cross-hatch, plate tone, warm black ink and plate mark on cream rag.
description_zh: 铜版硬地蚀刻：酸咬细线、密排交叉线、版调、暖黑墨与乳色棉纸上的版痕。

description_en: Waxy oil-pastel sticks: scumbled broken color, crayon ridges, paper tooth in gaps, smudge beside hard unblended edges.
description_zh: 油性粉彩棒：断色擦涂、蜡质笔脊、纸齿露底、晕擦与硬边并存。

description_en: Layered jianzhi cut paper: razor silhouettes, negative-space cuts, stacked crimson-cream-teal sheets with paper-cast shadows.
description_zh: 分层剪纸：锋利剪影、镂空纹样、红奶油青绿叠纸与纸影。

description_en: Rimpa school: gold-leaf ground, tarashikomi mineral blooms, bold simplified flora and waves in malachite and azurite.
description_zh: 琳派：金箔地、溜込矿物渗化、简化花草波浪与石绿石青。

description_en: Collotype photomechanical print: reticulated gelatin grain, continuous-tone warm brown-black ink on thick cream paper.
description_zh: 珂罗版：重铬酸盐明胶网纹颗粒、连续调暖棕黑墨、厚奶油纸。

description_en: Black, sanguine, and white chalk on mid-tone laid paper; stump blend, hatching, white heightening.
description_zh: 黑、红赭与白粉笔于中间调纸；擦笔晕、排线、白粉笔提亮。

description_en: Heliogravure intaglio: reticulated aquatint grain, velvety continuous-tone sepia-black ink, plate mark on cream rag.
description_zh: 照相凹版：飞尘网纹颗粒、绒面连续调棕黑墨、乳色棉纸版痕。

description_en: Manga zip-a-tone: G-pen contours, pasted halftone sheets, gradient dots, white-out, black ink on white paper.
description_zh: 漫画网点纸：G笔轮廓、粘贴网纹、渐变网点、修正白、白纸黑墨。

description_en: Warp-resist dye weaving: feathered motif edges, indigo-madder-mustard yarns, visible weft and cloth tooth.
description_zh: 经线扎染织造：纹样羽化边、靛红芥黄纱、可见纬线与布齿。

description_en: Freehand expressive ink-and-color: calligraphic wet brush, spare mineral washes, large xuan-paper reserve; not gongbi.
description_zh: 写意水墨设色：书法性湿笔、疏淡矿物色、大量宣纸留白；非工笔。

description_en: Rubbed graphite and crayon over relief textures; wood grain and stone transfer as the look.
description_zh: 石墨与蜡笔拓擦浮雕纹理；木纹石纹转印作为主导画风。

description_en: Rice-paste stencil resist on hemp: indigo-persimmon dye, katagami rims, cloth weave.
description_zh: 型纸防染：靛蓝与柿涩、型纸硬边、麻布织纹可见。

description_en: Relief impression into cotton paper: ink squash, tactile bite, limited spot inks.
description_zh: 凸版压入棉纸：油墨外溢、纸面咬痕、限色专色。

description_en: Copper-plate stipple: image from graver dots and flicks, velvety dotted tone, plate mark.
description_zh: 铜版点刻：点与剔刀构成形体，绒面网点调子与版痕。

description_en: Layered wax-pigment pencils on toothy paper: directional hatch, burnish, paper tooth in lights.
description_zh: 蜡质彩铅叠层：定向排线、压光密色、亮部露纸齿。

description_en: Lumière autochrome plate: potato-starch dyed grain mosaic, muted pointillist color, warm amber glass-plate veil.
description_zh: 卢米埃尔奥托克罗姆：淀粉颗粒彩网、低饱和点彩、暖琥珀玻璃底片罩。

description_en: Multi-stone color lithography: opaque overprinted inks, slight plate misregister, crayon-on-stone grain, cream paper.
description_zh: 多石彩色石印：不透明叠墨、轻微套印偏移、蜡笔石纹、乳色纸。

description_en: Sprinkled-metal urushi: gold and silver powder in wet lacquer, togidashi polish, black lacquer ground.
description_zh: 莳绘漆艺：金银粉洒入湿漆、研出抛光、黑漆地。

description_en: Pictorialist bromoil: bleached gelatin inked with greasy litho inks, brush-inked highlights, warm brown-black grain.
description_zh: 画意溴油印相：漂白明胶着油墨、笔刷提亮、暖棕黑颗粒。

description_en: Torn-washi collage painting: deckle fiber edges, layered colored paper, sparse sumi accents; not papercut.
description_zh: 撕纸画：和纸毛边、色纸叠层、疏淡墨线；非剪纸。

description_en: Outline-only Chinese ink: calligraphic contour, unfilled form, cream xuan reserve; no wash, not xieyi, not gongbi color.
description_zh: 白描：书法性墨线、不填色、宣纸留白；无渲染，非写意，非工笔设色。

description_en: Paste-resist silk dyeing: rice-paste walls, hand-painted dye floods, crepe weave; not katazome, not batik, not ikat.
description_zh: 友禅：糊防染轮廓、手绘染料晕染、绉绸织纹；非型染、非蜡染、非经扎染。

description_en: Mercury-fumed silvered copper plate: mirror specular, ultra-fine grain, plate tarnish; not wet collodion, not bromoil.
description_zh: 达盖尔银版：水银熏银铜板、镜面高光、极细颗粒与氧化边；非湿版火棉胶、非溴油。

description_en: Veneer inlay: knife-cut walnut maple rosewood ebony, grain as shading, French polish; not mosaic, not maki-e.
description_zh: 细木镶嵌：刀切胡桃枫木紫檀乌木、木纹作明暗、法式抛光；非马赛克、非莳绘。

description_en: Egg-white coated paper print: glossy warm sepia silver image, contact-print sharpness; not bromoil, not autochrome.
description_zh: 蛋白印相：蛋白涂布纸、暖褐光泽银影、接触印相锐度；非溴油、非奥托克罗姆。

description_en: Turkish paper marbling: mineral pigments on sized water, combed stone and gelgit veins transferred to paper; not suminagashi, not watercolor wash.
description_zh: 土耳其水拓：矿物颜料浮于胶液水面、梳出石纹与波浪后拓于纸；非墨流、非水彩晕染。

description_en: Smoke painting: candle and lamp soot deposited on paper, fixed carbon plumes and scorch veils; not charcoal, not carbon dust, not mezzotint.
description_zh: 烟熏绘：烛烟灯炱沉积于纸、定影后的碳羽与焦边；非炭笔、非炭粉画、非美柔汀。

description_en: Tie-resist indigo dyeing: bound kanoko, mokume folds, itajime clamps, white reserve on ai-iro cloth; not batik, not ikat, not katazome.
description_zh: 绞缬：绑扎鹿子、木目褶皱、板締め几何、白留与蓝靛布；非蜡染、非经扎染、非型染。

description_en: Ferrotype on japanned iron: wet-collodion positive, pewter highlights, chocolate midtones, plate varnish; not daguerreotype, not albumen print.
description_zh: 铁版照相：漆铁湿版正像、锡色高光、巧克力中间调、漆面；非达盖尔银版、非蛋白印相。

description_en: Cut gold leaf: hairline strips and geometric lattice on mineral-pigment ground; not maki-e sprinkled lacquer, not cloisonnism.
description_zh: 截金：切金箔细条与几何格子贴于矿物色地；非莳绘洒金、非景泰蓝主义。

description_en: Hand-drawn Indian textile: iron-mordant kalam outlines, vegetable madder-indigo-myrobalan dyes, floral vine borders on cotton; not batik, not ukiyo-e.
description_zh: 卡拉姆卡里：铁媒竹笔勾线、植物茜红靛蓝诃子黄、棉布藤蔓边饰；非蜡染、非浮世绘。

description_en: Open-backed translucent enamel: light through vitreous cells, gold filigree cloisons, jewel glow; not stained glass, not cloisonnism painting.
description_zh: 镂空珐琅：无底透光釉室、金丝掐丝、宝石通透；非彩绘玻璃、非景泰蓝主义绘画。

description_en: Surrealist paint-pull: pigment pressed and peeled, Rorschach blots, feathery transfer ridges; not watercolor wash, not fumage.
description_zh: 移画法：夹压揭开颜料、墨渍对称、羽毛状转印肌理；非水彩晕染、非烟熏绘。

description_en: Platinum-palladium print: matte paper, luminous greys, warm-neutral midtones, contact-print bite; not daguerreotype, not tintype, not albumen.
description_zh: 铂盐印相：哑光纸、铂灰高光、暖中性中间调、接触印相锐度；非达盖尔银版、非铁版、非蛋白印相。

description_en: Intaglio with laminated tissue: gampi/China paper patches, plate emboss, colored collé under etched line; not chigiri-e, not letterpress.
description_zh: 薄纸拼贴版：雁皮薄纸压合、凹版压痕、色纸衬于蚀刻线；非撕纸画、非凸版压印。

description_en: Japanese water-based woodblock: washi, bokashi gradations, baren grain, limited mineral inks; not linocut, not wood engraving, not painted ukiyo-e.
description_zh: 水印木刻：和纸、ぼかし渐层、马楝木纹、矿物水性颜料；非油性木刻、非木口木刻、非手绘浮世绘。

description_en: Mother-of-pearl inlay in black urushi: iridescent nacre tesserae, polished lacquer, shell flash; not maki-e gold dust, not kirikane leaf.
description_zh: 螺钿：黑漆嵌鲍贝、虹彩贝片、抛光漆面；非莳绘金粉、非截金箔切。

description_en: Tin-glazed tile mural: cobalt-white maiolica, grout grid, crackle glaze; not mosaic tesserae, not stained glass, not Delft transfer.
description_zh: 阿兹勒霍：锡釉瓷砖壁画、钴蓝白、砖缝网格、开片釉；非马赛克、非彩绘玻璃、非代尔夫特转印。

description_en: 1840s salted-paper photograph: matte warm brown-lilac silver, paper fiber, no albumen gloss; not daguerreotype, not platinotype, not cyanotype.
description_zh: 盐纸印相：哑光暖棕紫银影、纸纤维可见、无蛋白光泽；非达盖尔银版、非铂盐、非蓝晒。

description_en: Enamel fused in carved metal recesses: opaque vitreous cells, raised metal ridges, fire-scale bubbles; not plique-à-jour, not cloisonnism painting.
description_zh: 錾胎珐琅：金属挖槽填不透明釉、凸起金属脊、烧成气泡；非镂空珐琅、非景泰蓝主义绘画。

description_en: Okinawan stencil-resist dyeing: rice-paste resist, vivid tropical pigments, crisp stencil edges; not katazome, not yuzen, not shibori, not batik.
description_zh: 红型：冲绳型染、米糊防染、鲜艳矿物色、型纸锐边；非型染京风、非友禅、非绞缬、非蜡染。

description_en: Wire-cell enamel: gold cloisons filled with opaque vitreous glaze, polished flush; not cloisonnism painting, not champlevé, not plique-à-jour.
description_zh: 掐丝珐琅：金丝隔室填不透明釉、磨平抛光；非景泰蓝主义绘画、非錾胎珐琅、非镂空珐琅。

description_en: Florentine hardstone inlay: cut lapis, malachite, jasper fitted hairline, polished mineral sheen; not wood marquetry, not grouted mosaic, not raden.
description_zh: 硬石镶嵌：切割青金石、孔雀石、碧玉严丝拼合、抛光石面；非细木镶嵌、非填缝马赛克、非螺钿。

description_en: Iron-silver brown print on paper: chocolate-sepia, matte fiber, chemical wash edges; not salt print, not albumen, not platinotype, not cyanotype.
description_zh: 范戴克棕印：铁银棕影、哑光纸纤维、药液边晕；非盐纸、非蛋白、非铂盐、非蓝晒。

description_en: Taisho–Showa woodblock: bokashi gradations, fine keyblock, atmospheric perspective; not Edo ukiyo-e, not generic mokuhanga, not rimpa.
description_zh: 新版画：大正昭和木版、ぼかし晕色、细墨线、空气透视；非江户浮世绘、非泛水印木刻、非琳派。

description_en: Freehand rice-paste resist on indigo cotton: piped paste lines, vegetable-dye fills, cloth weave bleed; not katazome stencil, not yuzen, not bingata, not batik.
description_zh: 筒描：手绘米糊防染、靛蓝底、植物染料填色、布纹渗边；非型染、非友禅、非红型、非蜡染。

description_en: Tin-glazed earthenware: opaque white ground, cobalt-copper-antimony-manganese oxides, pooled gloss; not azulejo tilework, not fresco, not porcelain.
description_zh: 马约利卡：锡白釉陶、钴铜锑锰釉上彩、积釉光泽；非阿兹勒霍、非湿壁画、非瓷器。

description_en: Talbot paper-negative print: fibrous rag grain, tan-lilac, soft low contrast; not daguerreotype, not salt print, not albumen, not wet collodion, not van dyke brown.
description_zh: 卡罗法：纸底负片、纤维纹、褐紫低反差；非达盖尔、非盐纸、非蛋白、非湿版、非范戴克棕印。

description_en: Hard Conté sticks on toned paper: earth-red, black, white, crisp hatch, paper tooth; not chalk pastel, not oil pastel, not sanguine-only, not trois crayons, not carbon dust.
description_zh: 康泰粉笔：硬蜡粉笔、赭红黑白、清晰排线、纸齿；非粉笔粉彩、非油性粉彩、非单纯红粉笔、非三色粉笔、非炭粉画。

description_en: Carved urushi packed with gold powder: incised hairlines on black/cinnabar lacquer; not maki-e sprinkle, not kirikane cut leaf, not raden.
description_zh: 沉金：漆面阴刻填金粉、黑漆或朱漆底、发丝刻线；非莳绘洒金、非截金、非螺钿。

description_en: Sun-faded plant-juice photographic print: chlorophyll, berry, and turmeric dyes on paper; not cyanotype blue, not gum bichromate, not salt-print sepia.
description_zh: 花汁印相：植物汁液日光晒印、叶绿素与姜黄淡染、低反差纸纹；非蓝晒、非树胶重铬酸盐、非盐纸。

description_en: Japanese indigo vat dye: layered blues, white resist reserves, cloth tooth; not shibori crinkle, not ikat warp, not batik wax, not katazome stencil.
description_zh: 蓝染：多层靛蓝浸染、留白防染、布纹齿感；非绞缬褶皱、非经扎染、非蜡染龟裂、非型染浆防。

description_en: Reverse-gilded glass: gold/silver leaf engraved behind glass with black asphaltum field; not stained glass, not kirikane, not maki-e, not cloisonné.
description_zh: 反绘金箔：玻璃背面贴金银箔再阴刻、黑漆底、镜面反光；非彩绘玻璃、非截金、非莳绘、非掐丝珐琅。

description_en: Chinese slit-tapestry silk weave: weft-faced color blocks, vertical slits, woven sheen; not embroidery, not yuzen, not kalamkari.
description_zh: 缂丝：通经断纬、色块竖缝、丝织光泽；非刺绣针脚、非友禅、非卡拉姆卡里。

description_en: Hayter simultaneous intaglio: lean and fat inks of different tack from one plate, overlapping translucent hues; not risograph, not screen overlay, not rainbow-roll litho.
description_zh: 粘度套印：同一凹版以不同油性油墨一次叠印、半透明色层；非孔版套印、非丝网叠印、非彩虹石印。

description_en: Caravaggesque tenebrism: a single hard shaft of light carving form from pitch-black umber; not generic chiaroscuro, not void black-ground illust, not cinematic rim light.
description_zh: 暗色主义：一束硬光从近黑中凿出形体；非普通明暗法、非黑底插画、非电影轮廓光。

description_en: Splashed-ink on xuan: explosive blooms, runbacks and controlled accidents; not xieyi lyric brush, not mogu boneless color, not suminagashi marbling.
description_zh: 泼墨：宣纸上的墨瀑、回渗与受控偶然；非写意笔意、非没骨设色、非墨流大理石纹。

description_en: Laminated copper-gold-silver forged into wood-grain metal strata; not wood photography, not damascus as weapon, not marquetry.
description_zh: 木目金：铜金银叠锻成木纹金属层；非木纹摄影、非大马士革兵器、非细木镶嵌。

description_en: Carved cinnabar lacquer in stacked vermillion urushi relief; not cloisonné wires, not maki-e sprinkled gold, not chinkin gold-fill incising.
description_zh: 堆朱：多层朱红漆剔刻浮雕；非掐丝珐琅、非莳绘洒金、非沉金填金阴刻。

description_en: Hammered sheet metal raised from the reverse into relief, planishing facets and punch texture; not line engraving, not mokume-gane grain, not cast sculpture.
description_zh: 锤揲：从背面锤起薄金属浮雕、锤痕与錾点；非线刻铜版、非木目金纹理、非浇铸雕塑。

description_en: Cameraless rayograph: objects and figure exposed as white-grey silhouettes on chemical black paper; not cyanotype blue, not digital cutout, not collage UI.
description_zh: 物影照片：实物与人影在银盐相纸上曝光成白灰剪影；非蓝晒、非数字抠图、非拼贴界面。

description_en: Black silver-sulfide inlay flushed into engraved silver; not cloisonné wires, not mokume-gane grain, not paper etching.
description_zh: 乌银镶嵌：硫化银填入阴刻银地再磨平；非掐丝珐琅、非木目金、非纸本蚀刻。

description_en: Thin transparent oil films over warm underpainting so flesh glows optically; not tenebrism, not impasto peaks, not watercolor wash.
description_zh: 透明罩染：暖色底上多层薄油色使肤色光学透光；非暗色主义、非厚涂、非水彩晕染。

description_en: Plank-grain relief print: gouge chatter, flat ink, wood grain in reserves; not wood engraving, not mokuhanga watercolor, not linocut.
description_zh: 木面木刻：顺纹刨面、刀痕与留白木纹；非木口木刻、非水印木刻、非油毡木刻。

description_en: Pigmented gelatin carbon process: velvety continuous tone with slight relief in darks; not silver grain, not bromoil brush, not gum bichromate.
description_zh: 碳印法：色素明胶转印、丝绒连续调、暗部微浮雕；非银盐颗粒、非溴油笔触、非树胶重铬酸盐。

description_en: Silicon-carbide grit collagraph intaglio: velvety granulated blacks, wiped paper lights, plate-mark; not mezzotint rocker, not aquatint rosin, not charcoal dust.
description_zh: 金刚砂版画：碳化硅颗粒粘版凹印、丝绒颗粒黑、擦白纸光、印痕；非美柔汀摇刀、非飞尘松香、非炭粉。

description_en: Layered urushi lacquer painting: wet-black and vermilion polish, brush-laid ridges, cured depth; not maki-e gold powder, not carved tsuishu, not chinkin.
description_zh: 漆画：多层生漆、湿黑与朱红高光、刷痕积边；非莳绘洒金、非堆朱剔刻、非沉金阴刻。

description_en: Chemigram on silver-gelatin paper: painted developer and resists under light, amber-black veils, hard chemical edges; not photogram silhouette, not cyanotype, not watercolor.
description_zh: 化学成像：在银盐相纸上涂显影与抗蚀剂、琥珀黑化学帷幕、硬边；非物影剪影、非蓝晒、非水彩。

description_en: Oil scumbling: opaque broken color dragged dry over a darker underpainting so canvas tooth sparkles; not transparent glazing, not impasto peaks, not airbrush blend.
description_zh: 干擦薄涂：不透明色在干透底色上干拖、画布齿露底闪光；非透明罩染、非厚涂峰、非喷绘融合。

description_en: Mordançage bleach-etch: lifted gelatin emulsion veils draped on a reddish-brown oxidized print; not photogram, not scratchboard, not digital glitch.
description_zh: 漂银腐蚀：漂蚀后乳剂揭起成半透明帷幕再贴回棕红氧化影像；非物影照片、非刮画、非数字故障。

description_en: Kintsugi gold-join: ceramic shard planes rejoined with thick gleaming gold lacquer seams and gold dust; not cloisonné wires, not stained-glass leading, not mosaic tesserae.
description_zh: 金缮：碎瓷片以厚金漆缝重新接合、金粉闪光；非掐丝珐琅、非彩绘玻璃铅条、非马赛克嵌片。

description_en: Tarashikomi Nihonga wet pooling: mineral pigments dropped into still-wet color so they bloom and marble on washi; not watercolor wash, not hatsuboku splash, not mogu boneless.
description_zh: 溜込：矿物颜料滴入未干色层、在和纸上洇开云纹；非水彩晕染、非泼墨、非没骨。

description_en: Sabattier solarization: partial tonal reversal with Mackie-line halos and pewter-silver midtones on analog gelatin; not neon glitch, not chemigram, not photogram.
description_zh: 中途曝光：局部影调反转、麦基线光晕与锡银色中间调；非霓虹故障、非化学成像、非物影照片。

description_en: Sashiko running stitch: even white cotton stitches in geometric asanoha and seigaiha on indigo cloth with visible weave and puckering; not satin-stitch embroidery, not cross-stitch, not papercut.
description_zh: 刺子绣：靛蓝布上均匀白线跑针、麻叶青海波几何、布纹微皱；非缎绣、非十字绣、非剪纸。

description_en: Guilloché engine-turning: rose-engine cycloid waves, banknote-fine line fields, enamel-filled recesses, metallic polish; not stipple engraving, not wood engraving, not filigree scrollwork.
description_zh: 引擎纹：玫瑰车花摆线波、钞票级细线场、珐琅填凹与金属抛光；非点刻铜版、非木口木刻、非金箔卷草。

description_en: Surrealist grattage: wet paint scraped over mesh, wood grain, and foil so accidental ridges and torn color fields form the figure; not sgraffito plaster, not scratchboard, not palette-knife impasto.
description_zh: 刮擦画：湿颜料在网、木纹与箔上刮过，偶然棱脊与撕裂色域成形；非刮刻灰泥、非刮画、非刮刀厚涂。

description_en: Lumen print: camera-less sun/UV exposure of photographic paper with botanicals, peach-lavender-teal chemical shifts and paper fog; not cyanotype, not anthotype, not photogram silhouette, not chemigram.
description_zh: 日光印相：相纸叠植物经日晒/紫外曝光，桃紫青绿化学变色与纸雾；非蓝晒、非花汁印相、非物影剪影、非化学成像。

description_en: Yamato-e: mineral pigments on silk or washi, gold-leaf cloud bands flattening space, high viewpoint and seasonal plants; not ukiyo-e, not shin-hanga, not nihonga, not rimpa screens.
description_zh: 大和绘：绢或和纸上岩彩，金云带压平空间，高视点与时令草木；非浮世绘、非新版画、非日本画、非琳派金屏。

description_en: Cliché-verre: needle drawing through smoked or coated glass, contact-printed onto photosensitive paper—etched contour plus photographic grain; not etching, not drypoint, not photogravure, not silverpoint.
description_zh: 玻璃底片绘：烟熏或涂布玻璃上针刻后接触印相，蚀线轮廓加照相颗粒；非蚀刻、非干刻、非照相凹版、非银尖素描。

description_en: Cuerda seca: greasy manganese resist cords separating pools of tin glaze on fired tile, glossy meniscus at dark outlines; not cloisonné wires, not azulejo painting, not majolica, not mosaic.
description_zh: 干绳彩釉：锰脂阻隔线分隔锡釉色池，烧成瓷砖高光与暗线弯月边；非掐丝珐琅、非阿兹勒霍、非马约利卡、非马赛克。

description_en: Sugar-lift aquatint: sugar solution painted on copper, bitten as painterly dark washes with lifted ivory reserves and plate tone; not line etching, not drypoint burr, not mezzotint, not watercolor.
description_zh: 糖水蚀刻：糖液绘于铜版再飞尘腐蚀，如画的深咬色块与留白纸地、版调；非线蚀、非干刻毛刺、非美柔汀、非水彩。

description_en: Camaieu: modeling in tints and shades of a single hue like a cameo, porcelain light; not grisaille gray, not brunaille, not monochrome-with-red-accent, not cyanotype.
description_zh: 单色浓淡：同一色相的深浅塑造如浮雕宝石，瓷质光影；非灰色单色、非褐色单色、非黑白加点红、非蓝晒。

description_en: Ambrotype: underexposed wet-plate collodion positive on dark glass, silvery cream highlights and velvet-black backing; not daguerreotype, not tintype, not calotype, not wet-collodion negative.
description_zh: 安布罗型：欠曝湿版火棉胶玻璃正片，银奶油高光与绒黑衬底；非达盖尔银版、非铁版照相、非卡罗法、非湿版负片。

description_en: Trencadís: irregular broken glazed ceramic shards in grout on curved biomorphic surfaces; not regular mosaic tesserae, not stained glass, not azulejo, not cuerda seca.
description_zh: 碎瓷镶嵌：不规则碎釉瓷片嵌于弯月灰缝与有机曲面；非规整马赛克、非彩绘玻璃、非阿兹勒霍、非干绳彩釉。

description_en: Otsu-e: Edo folk mineral pigments on tan washi, bold sumi outlines and flat color patches; not ukiyo-e woodblock, not yamato-e gold clouds, not shin-hanga, not gongbi.
description_zh: 大津绘：江户民间岩彩绘于茶色和纸，粗墨线与平涂色块；非浮世绘木版、非大和绘金云、非新版画、非工笔。

description_en: Alla prima: wet-into-wet oil finished in one sitting, juicy loaded strokes and melting edges; not dried oil glazing, not scumbling haze, not sculpted impasto peaks, not palette-knife slabs.
description_zh: 直接画法：一次完成的湿碰湿油画，饱满笔触与溶边；非透明罩染、非干擦薄涂、非雕塑式厚涂峰、非调色刀铲涂。

description_en: Sumi-e: graded Japanese ink wash on raw paper, five ink tones, calligraphic bone-and-flesh stroke and empty space; not haboku splash, not gongbi outline-fill, not mogu color bloom, not nihonga mineral pigment.
description_zh: 水墨画：生纸上的浓淡墨阶、骨法用笔与留白；非泼墨、非工笔勾填、非没骨色晕、非日本画岩彩。

description_en: Soft-ground etching: vernis mou intaglio with crumbly crayon-like bite and fabric-texture impressions, plate tone on cream paper; not hard-ground needle etching, not drypoint burr, not aquatint dust, not sugar-lift wash.
description_zh: 软地蚀刻：软蜡凹版，粉质蜡笔般咬痕与织物压纹、版调印于米色纸；非硬地针蚀、非干刻毛刺、非飞尘、非糖水蚀刻。

description_en: Woodburytype: continuous-tone pigmented gelatin relief, almost grainless chocolate-sepia; not carbon-print tissue, not photogravure rosin grain, not collotype reticulation, not albumen gloss.
description_zh: 伍德伯里型：连续调明胶浮雕色素印，近无颗粒的巧克力棕；非碳印法、非照相凹版松香粒、非珂罗版网纹、非蛋白印相高光。

description_en: White-line woodcut: Provincetown single-block method, V-groove white channels separating painted color fields; not mokuhanga multi-block, not black keyblock, not chiaroscuro woodcut tone blocks, not wood engraving.
description_zh: 白线木刻：普罗温斯敦单版法，V槽白线分隔着色色域；非水印木刻多版套印、非墨线主版、非明暗木刻分层、非木口木刻。

description_en: Gyotaku: direct-inked relief rubbing transferred onto washi, uneven sumi load and paper-fiber bite; not woodcut keyblock, not frottage charcoal rub, not mokuhanga multi-block, not letterpress.
description_zh: 鱼拓：物面着墨后拓于和纸，墨量不均与纸纤维咬痕；非木刻主版、非拓印擦绘、非水印木刻多版、非凸版压印。

description_en: Jiehua: Chinese ruled-line painting, straightedge architecture with mineral fills; not gongbi figure-first, not yamato-e gold clouds, not ligne claire, not CAD wireframe.
description_zh: 界画：界尺建筑线描与石色填彩；非工笔人物优先、非大和绘金云、非清晰线条漫画、非CAD线框。

description_en: Verdaccio: olive-green terre-verte underpainting modeling form before flesh color; not grisaille grey, not camaieu single-hue, not sfumato haze, not oil glazing.
description_zh: 绿灰底层：土绿橄榄灰底层塑形后再敷肉色；非灰色单色、非单色浓淡、非烟雾法、非透明罩染。

description_en: Crayon manner: manière de crayon intaglio, roulette grain imitating chalk on cream laid paper with a plate mark; not stipple engraving, not aquatint, not soft-ground etching, not trois crayons drawing.
description_zh: 粉笔凹版：滚点工具仿粉笔颗粒的凹版，印于有版痕的米色布纹纸；非点刻铜版、非飞尘蚀刻、非软地蚀刻、非三色粉笔画。

description_en: Basse-taille: translucent vitreous enamel over chased low-relief metal, engraved hatch visible through the glass color; not cloisonné wires, not champlevé cells, not plique-à-jour openwork, not painted Limoges enamel.
description_zh: 浅浮雕珐琅：透明珐琅覆于锤錾浅浮雕金属，底纹透过釉色；非掐丝珐琅、非錾胎珐琅、非镂空珐琅、非利摩日画珐琅。

description_en: Divisionism: form built from discrete elongated dashes of pure complementary hues that mix optically at a distance; not circular Pointillism dots, not blended Impressionist color, not mosaic tesserae inlay.
description_zh: 分割主义：以纯色互补的短条笔触并置、远观光学混色成形；非圆形点彩、非印象派融色、非镶嵌马赛克。

description_en: Spit bite: nitric acid painted onto a rosin aquatint ground, yielding painterly bitten washes, tide-line rings, and corrosive blooms; not even aquatint grain, not sugar-lift, not watercolor on paper.
description_zh: 唾液咬蚀：硝酸直接涂于松香飞尘底，形成潮线与腐蚀云团般的咬色；非均匀飞尘、非糖水蚀刻、非纸本水彩。

description_en: Kallitype: iron-silver contact print in warm chocolate-to-eggplant brown sitting in rag-paper fibers; not Van Dyke brown, not platinum-palladium cool grey, not cyanotype blue, not glossy silver-gelatin.
description_zh: 卡利型：铁银接触印相，暖巧克力至茄紫棕色渗入棉纸纤维；非范戴克棕印、非铂钯冷灰、非蓝晒、非光面银盐。

description_en: Intarsia: pictorial image from thick cut pieces of different wood species set flush, grain direction and knife seams visible; not thin-veneer marquetry, not pietra dura stone, not pyrography, not painting on wood.
description_zh: 嵌木细工：不同树种厚木块嵌平成像，木纹走向与刀缝可见；非薄皮细木镶嵌、非硬石镶嵌、非烙画、非木板绘画。

description_en: Reduction linocut: successive cuts on a single linoleum block printed light-to-dark with overlapping ink films and gouge marks; not multi-block linocut, not woodcut, not screenprint, not risograph.
description_zh: 减版油印：同一油毡版逐次削减、由浅入深叠印，刀痕与套色错位可见；非多版油印、非木刻、非丝网、非孔版印刷。

description_en: Trompe-l'œil: illusionistic panel painting that fools the eye with painted niches, peeling paper, cast shadows and tactile stone; not photoreal CGI, not collage, not cubism, not plain oil portrait.
description_zh: 视错觉绘画：以画成的壁龛、卷边纸、投影与石材触感欺骗眼睛；非写实三维渲染、非拼贴、非立体派、非普通油画肖像。

description_en: Palladium print (palladiotype): warm olive-gray metallic midtones on matte paper tooth, long scale without carbon blacks; not platinum-only platinotype, not silver gelatin, not cyanotype, not Van Dyke brown.
description_zh: 钯盐印相：哑光纸齿上偏暖橄榄灰金属中间调、长阶调而无炭黑；非纯铂盐、非银盐明胶、非蓝晒、非范戴克棕印。

description_en: Nerikomi: pictorial field from laminated colored clays, agateware striations and cane-sliced floral cross-sections with clay-body seams; not a ceramic figurine object, not polymer clay, not ebru, not wood intarsia.
description_zh: 练込：层叠色泥成像，玛瑙纹与切片花纹泥棒断面、泥体接缝可见；非陶瓷人偶物件、非聚合物黏土、非水拓、非嵌木细工。

description_en: Tempera grassa: egg-oil emulsion, satin fusion faster than oil and softer than pure egg tempera hatching, luminous local color without heavy impasto; not egg tempera, not oil glazing, not gouache, not acrylic.
description_zh: 油性蛋彩：蛋油乳液，比油画干得快、比纯蛋彩细笔更融合，缎面本地色而无厚堆；非蛋彩细笔、非透明罩染、非水粉、非丙烯。

description_en: Millefiori: kiln-fused sliced glass murrine canes as a pictorial field, transparent and opaque discs with glass edges and bubbles; not stained-glass leading, not ceramic mosaic, not polymer clay, not kaleidoscope photo.
description_zh: 千花玻璃：窑融切片千花玻璃棒作为画面，透与不透圆片、玻璃边与气泡可见；非铅条彩绘玻璃、非陶瓷马赛克、非聚合物黏土、非万花筒照片。

description_en: Bokashi: nishiki-e woodblock color gradation from wet pigment on the block, baren-rubbed fades and slight misregister on washi; not mokuhanga outline-only, not modern ukiyo-e, not watercolor wash, not gouache.
description_zh: 木版渐层：锦绘湿色上版晕染、马连擦出的渐变与轻微套印偏移、和纸齿感；非仅勾线水印木刻、非现代浮世绘、非水彩晕染、非水粉。

description_en: Chrysotype: Herschel gold-salt print in rose-brown to purple-gold continuous tone on matte paper, no silver speculars; not platinotype, not palladium print, not kallitype, not Van Dyke brown, not gelatin silver.
description_zh: 金盐印相：赫歇尔金盐工艺，玫棕至紫金连续调、哑光纸基、无银盐高光；非铂盐、非钯盐、非卡利型、非范戴克棕印、非明胶银盐。

description_en: Nanga (bunjinga): Japanese literati ink with light mineral color, dry-brush flying white and empty space on xuan paper; not gongbi, not mogu, not xieyi splash-only, not sumi-e monochrome, not nihonga.
description_zh: 南画（文人画）：淡彩矿物与墨、飞白枯笔与留白宣纸；非工笔、非没骨、非纯写意泼墨、非单色水墨、非日本画重彩。

description_en: Or nué: pictorial goldwork of couched metal threads shaded by colored silk, directional sheen and raised couching; not general embroidery, not sashiko, not kirikane, not maki-e, not kesi.
description_zh: 晕金绣：平金线以彩丝分色罩染、金属光向与凸起钉线；非普通刺绣、非刺子绣、非截金、非莳绘、非缂丝。

description_en: Line engraving: burin-cut tapering lines and lozenge hatch on copper, plate tone on laid paper, no etch grain; not etching, not drypoint, not mezzotint, not stipple engraving, not wood engraving.
description_zh: 线刻铜版：雕刀渐粗细线与菱形交叉排线、铺纸版调、无酸咬颗粒；非蚀刻、非干刻、非美柔汀、非点刻铜版、非木口木刻。

description_en: Aizuri-e: Edo woodblock printed almost entirely in Prussian/Berlin blue (bero-ai) on washi, blue bokashi and baren grain; not aizome textile, not cyanotype, not full-color nishiki-e, not watercolor wash.
description_zh: 蓝摺绘：以柏林蓝（ベロ蓝）为主的江户木版、蓝色渐层与马连齿痕、和纸；非蓝染织物、非蓝晒、非全彩锦绘、非水彩晕染。

description_en: Kirazuri: woodblock mica (kira) ground, pearly mineral sparkle on washi with printed line; not kirikane cut gold, not maki-e, not or nué, not raden, not digital glitter.
description_zh: 云母摺：木版云母地、和纸上的矿物珠光与版线；非截金、非莳绘、非晕金绣、非螺钿、非数码闪粉。

description_en: Fresco secco: pigment bound on already-dry lime plaster, matte chalky mural with giornata seams; not buon fresco, not egg tempera, not gouache wash, not casein, not distemper.
description_zh: 干壁画：颜料绘于已干石灰墙、哑光粉质与日作业缝；非湿壁画、非蛋彩、非水粉湿画、非酪蛋白、非胶彩。

description_en: Ben-Day dots: mid-century comic process screens of regular CMYK circles on newsprint, rosettes and slight misregister; not neon halftone, not manga screentone, not risograph, not pointillism, not photogravure.
description_zh: 本戴网点：世纪中漫画工艺圆点、新闻纸套色与轻微错位；非霓虹网点、非漫画网点纸、非孔版印刷、非点彩、非照相凹版。

description_en: Distemper: animal-glue size paint, matte chalky opaque body like scene painting; not gouache wash, not casein, not egg tempera, not fresco, not acrylic, not oil impasto.
description_zh: 胶彩：动物胶结合的哑光不透明颜料、布景画体质；非水粉湿画、非酪蛋白、非蛋彩、非壁画、非丙烯、非厚涂油画。

description_en: Nishiki-e: full-color brocade woodblock with keyblock outlines and layered mineral flats; not aizuri-e, not kirazuri, not mokuhanga watercolor bleed, not shin-hanga, not modern ukiyo-e digital.
description_zh: 锦绘：多色锦缎木版，主版墨线加矿物色平涂套印；非蓝摺绘、非云母摺、非水印木刻晕染、非新版画、非现代数码浮世绘。

description_en: Tonalism: close-valued muted atmosphere, forms dissolved in colored air, quiet veiled light; not void chiaroscuro, not tenebrism, not sfumato, not grisaille, not camaieu, not divisionism.
description_zh: 色调主义：近明度低彩氛围，形体溶入色气与薄光；非黑底明暗法、非暗色主义、非烟雾法、非灰色单色、非单色浓淡、非分割主义。

description_en: Gelatin silver: analog fiber-base black-and-white print, silver grain and Dmax blacks; not daguerreotype, not tintype, not wet collodion, not platinum/palladium, not cyanotype, not carbon print.
description_zh: 明胶银盐：纤维纸基黑白银盐照片，银粒与深黑密度；非达盖尔银版、非铁版照相、非湿版火棉胶、非铂钯印相、非蓝晒、非碳印法。

description_en: Kappazuri: woodblock key line plus hand-stenciled color islands, dry opaque stencil pigment; not katazome, not pochoir, not screen print overlay, not bingata, not nishiki-e brocade, not risograph.
description_zh: 合羽摺：木版墨线加合羽型纸填色，干爽不透明色块；非型染、非镂版上色、非丝网叠印、非红型、非锦绘、非孔版印刷。

description_en: Haiga: spare haiku-painting, few ink strokes, pale wash, empty paper, abbreviated wit; not sumi-e landscape, not xieyi splash, not gongbi, not mogu, not nanga, not hatsuboku, not baimiao.
description_zh: 俳画：俳句式简笔，淡墨淡渲与大片留白；非水墨全景、非写意泼洒、非工笔、非没骨、非南画、非泼墨、非白描。

description_en: Karazuri: uninked woodblock blind embossing, white-on-white raised washi relief, sparse dry keyblock; not kirazuri mica, not nishiki-e brocade, not bokashi, not letterpress type, not mokuhanga watercolor bleed.
description_zh: 空摺：无墨木版压出白上白浮凸和纸肌理，仅少量干墨主线；非云母摺、非锦绘、非木版渐层、非凸版铅字、非水印木刻晕染。

description_en: Pâte-de-verre: kiln-cast crushed-glass paste, granular frit glow, satin fused mass and trapped bubbles; not stained glass leading, not cloisonné, not verre églomisé, not plique-à-jour, not millefiori canes.
description_zh: 熔铸玻璃：碎玻璃糊窑铸，颗粒内光与亚光熔体、气泡；非彩绘玻璃铅条、非景泰蓝、非玻璃背面贴金、非镂空珐琅、非千花玻璃。

description_en: Dye transfer: analog three-color imbibition print, rich continuous-tone dye on gelatin paper; not gelatin silver, not autochrome mosaic, not chromolithograph, not inkjet, not carbon print.
description_zh: 染料转印：三色吸墨转印，明胶纸上浓郁连续调染料层；非明胶银盐、非奥托克罗姆色网、非彩色石版、非喷墨、非碳印法。

description_en: Metalcut: 15th-century dotted manner, punched white dots in a black metal-relief field, white-line ornament; not woodcut grain, not line engraving, not stipple engraving, not mezzotint, not etching burr.
description_zh: 金属凸版：十五世纪点刻法，黑底打出白点与白线纹饰；非木刻木纹、非线刻铜版、非点刻铜版、非美柔汀、非蚀刻毛刺。

description_en: Mishima: incised or stamped stoneware inlaid with white slip, scraped flush buncheong-mishima lines; not sashiko, not sgraffito, not cuerda seca, not nerikomi, not kintsugi.
description_zh: 三岛嵌：灰褐陶胎刻印填白化妆土再刮平的镶嵌线纹；非刺子绣、非刮刻灰泥、非干线法、非练込、非金缮。

description_en: Mokulito: greasy litho crayon and tusche printed from plywood so wood grain ghosts through the tone; not stone lithograph, not woodcut, not wood engraving, not drypoint.
description_zh: 木石版画：在胶合板上用油性蜡笔与油墨水绘制再转印，木纹透入调子；非石印石版、非木面木刻、非木口木刻、非干刻。

description_en: Cibachrome: dye-bleach azo color on high-gloss polyester, extreme Dmax and hyper-chroma; not dye transfer, not autochrome, not gelatin silver, not chromogenic C-print.
description_zh: 西巴克罗姆：偶氮染料漂白法高光聚酯彩印，极深黑与超饱和；非染料转印、非奥托克罗姆、非明胶银盐、非成色彩扩。

description_en: Tsujigahana: shibori-reserved blotches plus ink drawing and gold leaf on silk; not yuzen, not katazome, not bingata, not plain shibori, not batik.
description_zh: 辻花染：绞缬留白晕斑加墨绘与金箔于丝绸；非友禅、非型染、非红型、非单纯绞缬、非蜡染。

description_en: Stumpwork: padded satin stitch, wired slips and needlelace in raised silk relief on linen; not flat embroidery, not or nué, not sashiko, not needle felt.
description_zh: 垫绣：填充缎绣、金属丝脱卸花瓣与针织蕾丝的立体丝线浮雕；非平面刺绣、非晕金绣、非刺子绣、非羊毛毡。

description_en: Toile de Jouy: monochrome copperplate pastoral line printed on cream cotton, fabric weave visible; not etching-on-paper, not letterpress, not chromolithograph, not ben-day dots.
description_zh: 茹伊印花：单色铜版田园线描印于乳色棉布，布纹可见；非纸本蚀刻、非凸版压印、非彩色石印、非本戴网点。

description_en: Benizuri-e: limited-color ukiyo-e with beni red and mineral green over a sumi keyblock on cream washi; not nishiki-e, not aizuri-e, not kirazuri, not karazuri.
description_zh: 红摺绘：红花红与矿物绿的有限套色浮世绘，墨线主版印于乳色和纸；非锦绘、非蓝摺绘、非云母摺、非空摺。

description_en: Lith print: infectious lith development with pepper-fog grain, snappy blacks and warm-cold midtones on fiber paper; not gelatin silver, not bromoil, not van dyke brown, not solarization.
description_zh: 锂显印相：感染性锂显、胡椒雾状颗粒、骤黑与冷暖中间调于钡地纸；非明胶银盐、非溴油、非范戴克棕、非中途曝光。

description_en: Qinglü: malachite and azurite mineral pigments in blue-green landscape manner with ink outline on silk; not mogu, not xieyi, not gongbi-only pale wash, not nihonga.
description_zh: 青绿：石青石绿矿物色的青绿山水法，墨线勾勒于绢；非没骨、非写意、非单纯工笔淡彩、非日本画。

description_en: Cameo glass: opaque white overlay wheel-cut through a translucent colored ground in high relief; not stained glass, not pâte-de-verre, not verre églomisé, not cloisonné.
description_zh: 浮雕套色玻璃：乳白套料经轮刻露出半透明色地的高浮雕；非彩绘玻璃、非熔铸玻璃、非玻璃金箔背面画、非掐丝珐琅。

description_en: Rozome: Japanese brush-drawn wax-resist dyeing with crackle veins and layered indigo-beni baths on cloth; not batik, not yuzen, not katazome, not shibori, not tsujigahana.
description_zh: 蜡缬：日本毛笔蜡防染，冰裂纹与靛蓝红花层层浸染于布；非爪哇蜡染、非友禅、非型染、非绞缬、非辻花染。

description_en: Sumizuri-e: early monochrome ukiyo-e woodblock in black sumi on washi with carved keyline and baren rub; not nishiki-e, not benizuri-e, not aizuri-e, not mokuhanga color.
description_zh: 墨摺絵：早期单色浮世绘木版，墨线与马楝擦印于和纸；非锦绘、非红摺绘、非蓝摺绘、非套色水印木刻。

description_en: Charcoal: vine and compressed charcoal on laid paper with kneaded-eraser lifts and paper tooth; not carbon dust, not graphite shine, not conté, not scratchboard, not mezzotint.
description_zh: 木炭素描：藤条炭与压缩炭在罗纹纸上，橡皮提出高光、纸纹可见；非炭粉画、非石墨反光、非康泰粉笔、非刮画、非美柔汀。

description_en: Sometsuke: cobalt gosu underglaze brush painting on white porcelain under clear glaze; not celadon, not aka-e overglaze, not cloisonné, not azulejo, not mishima inlay.
description_zh: 染付：钴蓝吴须在白瓷上的釉下彩，透明釉覆盖；非青瓷、非赤绘釉上彩、非掐丝珐琅、非阿兹勒霍、非三岛嵌。

description_en: Blackwork: counted-thread black silk on white linen with Holbein double-running stitch and geometric fills; not sashiko, not stumpwork, not or nué, not kesi, not toile de Jouy.
description_zh: 黑工绣：白亚麻上的计针黑丝线，霍尔拜因双面走针与几何填纹；非刺子绣、非垫绣、非晕金绣、非缂丝、非茹伊印花。

description_en: Reverse glass: Hinterglasmalerei pigments on the back of glass in reverse order, viewed through the glossy face; not stained glass, not verre églomisé, not cameo glass, not pâte-de-verre.
description_zh: 玻璃背面画：颜料按反向次序画在玻璃背面，透过光泽正面观看；非彩绘玻璃、非反绘金箔、非浮雕套色玻璃、非熔铸玻璃。

description_en: Ishizuri-e: reverse-impression ukiyo-e as a stone rubbing, raised white line on a matte black ground with paper-tooth grain; not sumizuri-e, not woodcut, not mezzotint, not scratchboard.
description_zh: 石摺絵：如碑拓的反向浮世绘，哑光黑地上的凸起白线与纸纹；非墨摺絵、非木刻、非美柔汀、非刮画。

description_en: Bistre: transparent soot-brown wash on cream laid paper with tide lines and dry-brush; not sanguine, not charcoal, not watercolor wash, not ink wash, not sepia photograph.
description_zh: 褐墨：乳色布纹纸上的透明煤烟棕彩，水渍边与枯笔；非红粉笔、非木炭、非水彩湿画、非水墨、非棕褐照片。

description_en: Gumoil: gum-bichromate matrix with oil pigment wiped into the image, velvety photographic grain and surface darks; not bromoil, not gum bichromate alone, not gelatin silver, not lith print, not oil painting.
description_zh: 树胶油彩印相：重铬酸盐树胶底上擦入油彩，丝绒般照相颗粒与表层暗部；非溴油、非单纯树胶重铬酸盐、非明胶银盐、非锂显、非油画。

description_en: Ajrakh: resist-and-mordant hand-block geometry in indigo, madder, and undyed cloth, slight misregister and visible weave; not batik, not ikat, not kalamkari, not yuzen, not toile de Jouy.
description_zh: 阿吉拉赫：防染与媒染木模几何纹，靛蓝、茜红与本色布，轻微错版与布纹；非蜡染、非经扎染、非卡拉姆卡里、非友禅、非茹伊印花。

description_en: Gold ground: burnished gold-leaf field with leaf joins and punchwork behind opaque tempera-like local color; not kirikane, not cloisonné, not mosaic, not stained glass, not oil glazing.
description_zh: 金地：抛光金箔底，箔接缝与錾花，人物为不透明蛋彩局部色；非截金、非景泰蓝、非马赛克、非彩绘玻璃、非油画罩染。

description_en: Iznik: Ottoman underglaze on white tin glaze in cobalt, turquoise, emerald, and bole red with black contours and saz-leaf arabesques, ceramic craquelure; not azulejo, not sometsuke, not majolica, not cuerda seca, not cloisonné.
description_zh: 伊兹尼克：白锡釉上钴蓝、青绿、翠绿与铁红釉下彩，黑线与萨兹叶卷草，釉面开片；非阿兹勒霍、非染付、非马约利卡、非干绳彩釉、非掐丝珐琅。

description_en: Scagliola: polished pigmented gypsum inlay imitating marble and hard-stone compartments, wax sheen and hairline joints; not pietra dura, not intarsia, not marquetry, not mosaic, not fresco.
description_zh: 仿石石膏嵌：着色石膏镶嵌仿大理石与硬石分格，蜡光与接缝细线；非硬石镶嵌、非嵌木、非细木镶嵌、非马赛克、非湿壁画。

description_en: Bandhani: tied-resist cloth of tiny undyed dots and puckered rings in indigo, turmeric, and madder; not shibori, not batik, not ikat, not ajrakh, not katazome.
description_zh: 班达尼：扎防染密点与皱环，靛蓝、姜黄与茜红；非绞缬、非蜡染、非经扎染、非阿吉拉赫、非型染。

description_en: Carbro: three-color carbon-bromide pigment transfer, matte paper tooth, slight register fringing, creamy highlights; not dye transfer, not monochrome carbon print, not cibachrome, not autochrome, not gum bichromate.
description_zh: 碳溴印相：三色碳溴色素转印，哑光纸齿、轻微套色偏移、乳色高光；非染料转印、非单色碳印、非西巴克罗姆、非奥托克罗姆、非树胶重铬酸盐。

description_en: Velatura: thin semi-opaque oil veils over dried underpaint, milky optical haze and under-hue shining through; not transparent oil glazing, not scumbling alone, not sfumato, not alla prima, not gouache wash.
description_zh: 薄纱罩染：半透明油彩薄纱覆于干透底色，乳雾光学与底色透出；非透明罩染、非单纯干擦、非烟雾法、非直接画法、非水粉湿画。

description_en: Raku: reduction-fired ceramic surface of smoked carbon, crackle (kanyuu) webs, iron-brown and cream glaze pools with kiln-flash copper; not celadon, not tenmoku oil-spot, not pottery-as-object still-life, not scagliola.
description_zh: 乐烧：还原烧成的烟熏碳黑、贯入开片、铁褐与乳白釉积及窑变铜晕；非青瓷、非天目油滴、非器物静物、非仿石石膏嵌。

description_en: Feibai: flying-white dry split-brush so paper streaks flash through each calligraphic stroke; not sumi-e wet wash, not hatsuboku splash-ink, not baimiao hairline, not gongbi, not xieyi blot.
description_zh: 飞白：枯笔散锋使纸白从笔画中闪过，书骨在痕；非水墨晕染、非泼墨、非白描细线、非工笔、非写意点厾。

description_en: Opalotype: 19th-century photographic positive on milky opal glass, pearly high-key bloom and soft photographic grain; not albumen print, not daguerreotype, not platinotype, not ambrotype, not gelatin silver.
description_zh: 乳白玻璃印相：十九世纪乳白玻璃上的照相正像，珠光高光与柔颗粒；非蛋白印相、非达盖尔、非铂盐、非玻璃负像、非明胶银盐。

description_en: Pâte-sur-pâte: successive thin translucent porcelain slips built into low cameo relief on a colored ground; not jasperware sprig, not cameo glass, not mishima inlay, not scagliola, not stone bas-relief.
description_zh: 堆泥薄饰：层层半透明瓷泥堆成浅浮雕，色地透出；非碧玉炻器贴花、非浮雕玻璃、非三岛嵌、非仿石石膏、非石刻浮雕。

description_en: Madhubani: Mithila double-line contours, flat natural-dye fills and dense geometric/floral fillers with no western shading; not kalamkari, not gongbi, not warli, not phad, not miniature painting.
description_zh: 马杜巴尼：米蒂拉双线勾勒、植物色平涂与繁密填充纹样，无西式明暗；非卡拉姆卡里、非工笔、非瓦尔利、非帕德、非细密画。

description_en: Pocai: splash-color on wet xuan, mineral azurite/malachite/cinnabar bled into ink pools; not hatsuboku ink-only, not mogu, not watercolor wash.
description_zh: 泼彩：湿宣泼洒石青石绿朱砂入墨渖；非纯泼墨、非没骨、非水彩晕染。

description_en: Thanjavur: gesso relief, inlaid glass-stone, gold-leaf fields and flat jewel local color in an arched niche; not gold-ground icon, not Madhubani, not miniature.
description_zh: 坦贾武尔：石膏浮雕、嵌玻璃石、金箔地与平涂宝石色拱龛；非金地圣像、非马杜巴尼、非细密画。

description_en: Petrykivka: translucent brush-tip floral-feather strokes (pyshchyk, zerniatko, tsybulka) in rhythmic ornament; not Madhubani double-line, not gongbi, not oil modeling.
description_zh: 彼得里基夫卡：半透明笔尖花羽笔触（pyshchyk、zerniatko、tsybulka）节奏纹样；非马杜巴尼双线、非工笔、非油画塑形。

description_en: Moriage: raised white slip beads and ridges on overglaze enamel with gold outline, Satsuma-like porcelain ground; not pâte-sur-pâte, not cloisonné, not raku.
description_zh: 盛上：白泥点线堆起、釉上彩与金线，萨摩式瓷地；非堆泥薄饰、非掐丝珐琅、非乐烧。

description_en: Warli: white rice-paste on earth-red geru, stick-and-circle geometry with hatched borders; not Madhubani, not kalamkari, not western shading.
description_zh: 瓦尔利：白米浆绘于赭红地，三角圆几何人体与锯齿边饰；非马杜巴尼、非卡拉姆卡里、非西式明暗。

description_en: Russian folk lacquer: black ground, vermillion, gold berry-and-leaf scrolls, travka strokes.
description_zh: 俄罗斯民间漆绘：黑地、朱红、金色浆果卷草与草叶笔。

description_en: Palekh lacquer miniature: jet ground, jewel tempera, hair-thin gold contours on papier-mâché.
description_zh: 帕列赫漆微型画：黑地、宝石蛋彩、发丝金线勾勒纸浆胎。

description_en: Oribe ware: copper-green glaze pools, iron-brown underglaze drawing on rustic stoneware.
description_zh: 织部烧：铜绿釉积、铁褐釉下绘、粗陶质地。

description_en: Nathdwara cloth painting: mineral pigments, lotus-pond ornament, gold highlights on cotton.
description_zh: 纳特瓦拉布画：矿物颜料、莲池纹饰、棉布金彩。

description_en: Polish folk paper-cut: layered scissor edges, bilateral florals, rooster medallions, hard color planes.
description_zh: 波兰民间剪纸：层叠刀口、左右对称花卉、公鸡团花、硬色块。

description_en: Calcutta bazaar painting: sweeping lampblack contours, flat mill-paper color, swift unmodeled anatomy, cheap handmade ground.
description_zh: 加尔各答集市画：挥扫焦黑轮廓、平涂土纸色、迅疾无明暗的形体、廉价手造纸底。

description_en: Pardhan Gond: signature dots and dashes infill every form, tree-of-life line networks, bright folk pigments, horror vacui patterning.
description_zh: 帕尔丹贡德：标志性点线填满形体、生命树线网、鲜亮民间颜料、满密装饰。

description_en: Kutani overglaze enamel: ko-Kutani five colors plus gold on porcelain white, vitreous gloss, dense bird-and-flower arabesque as surface technique.
description_zh: 九谷上绘：古九谷五彩加金、瓷白底、玻璃质光泽，密匝花鸟纹作为表面技法。

description_en: Korean minhwa: bright mineral pigments on hanji, bold ink outlines, flat festive space, little atmospheric perspective.
description_zh: 朝鲜民画：宣纸般韩纸上的矿物重彩、粗墨线、平面喜庆空间、几乎无空气透视。

description_en: American Luminism: concealed brushwork, crystalline air, mirror water, quiet glowing high-key light without theatrical chiaroscuro.
description_zh: 美国光辉主义：藏笔触、晶莹空气、镜面水色、静谧高调辉光而无戏剧明暗。

description_en: Odisha Pattachitra: cloth support, mineral pigments, bold black outlines, flat unshaded color, dense floral borders.
description_zh: 奥里萨帕塔奇特拉：布面矿物颜料、粗黑线、平涂无明暗、密花边框。

description_en: Persian miniature: opaque watercolor and gold, ultra-fine brush, jewel local color, high horizon, flattened patterned space.
description_zh: 波斯细密画：不透明水彩与金箔、极细笔、宝石固有色、高视平、平面纹样空间。

description_en: Moroccan zellige: hand-cut glazed tesserae, geometric star polygons, grout lines, tin-glaze cobalt and turquoise.
description_zh: 摩洛哥泽利格：手切釉陶马赛克、几何星纹、填缝线、锡釉钴蓝与青绿。

description_en: Sōsaku-hanga: self-carved woodblock, visible gouge, uneven baren impression, limited mineral pigments on washi.
description_zh: 创作版画：自刻木版、可见刀痕、不均马连压印、和纸上的有限矿物色。

description_en: Macchiaioli macchia method: plein-air value patches, Tuscan sun, abbreviated edges, oil masses instead of line.
description_zh: 斑块派：外光明暗色块、托斯卡纳日光、省略边缘、以色团代替线描。

description_en: Fauve oil: pure saturated pigments, arbitrary color modeling, loaded separate strokes, cobalt and crimson contour.
description_zh: 野兽派油画：纯色厚涂、任意设色、分离笔触、钴蓝与绯红轮廓。

description_en: Art Nouveau: whiplash botanical line, flat poster fields, gold ornament, 1890s lithographic decorative panel.
description_zh: 新艺术：鞭绳植物曲线、平面招贴色块、金饰、十九世纪末石版装饰板。

description_en: Thangka mineral painting: gold outline, stacked Himalayan space, rainbow aureole, lapis field, brocade border.
description_zh: 唐卡矿物色：金线、层叠喜马拉雅空间、虹光背光、群青底、织锦边。

description_en: Gzhel porcelain painting: cobalt-blue on white tin glaze, graded blue wash, floral scroll, ceramic sheen.
description_zh: 格热利瓷绘：白釉钴蓝、分层蓝晕、卷草纹、瓷釉光泽。

description_en: Nianhua woodblock: bold outline, flat mineral fills, slight misregister, festive Yangliuqing/Taohuawu print surface.
description_zh: 年画木版：粗墨线、平涂矿物色、轻微套印偏移、杨柳青/桃花坞纸面。

description_en: Art Deco: geometric sunburst, stepped ziggurat planes, chevron and fan ornament, lacquer black with gold and jade teal.
description_zh: 装饰艺术：几何旭日放射、阶梯金字塔块面、人字纹与扇形纹样、漆黑底配金箔与青绿。

description_en: Analytic Cubism: interlocking planar facets, multiple viewpoints, ochre-grey-umber construction of volume.
description_zh: 分析立体主义：咬合块面、多视点并置、赭灰棕体积拆解。

description_en: German Expressionism: jagged contour, agitated brush, raw non-natural color, anatomy bent for emotional force.
description_zh: 表现主义：锯齿轮廓、躁动笔触、非自然高饱和色、为情绪扭曲形体。

description_en: Veristic Surrealism: hyper-clear academic rendering of impossible scale, still air, long shadows, dream-logic objects.
description_zh: 写实超现实主义：学院派清晰笔法画不可能尺度、静止空气、长影与梦逻辑物象。

description_en: Op Art: hard-edge optical vibration, warped checkers and sine stripes, high-contrast moiré afterimage flicker.
description_zh: 欧普艺术：硬边视错振动、扭曲棋格与正弦条纹、高对比莫尔余像闪烁。

description_en: Impressionism: broken color, short complementary dabs, plein-air shimmer, no hard outlines, optical mix on canvas tooth.
description_zh: 印象派：色点分离、互补短笔触、外光颤动、无硬边线、画布齿纹上的光学混合。

description_en: Pop Art: flat primary blocks, thick graphic contour, commercial silkscreen space, CMYK punch, poster-flat figure.
description_zh: 波普艺术：平涂原色块、粗黑轮廓、商业丝网空间、CMYK冲击、招贴式扁平人物。

description_en: Italian Futurism: force lines, repeating limbs of speed, interpenetrating diagonals, dynamism and simultaneity.
description_zh: 未来主义：力线、速度重复肢体重影、斜向穿插块面、动态与同时性。

description_en: Photorealism: painted-photograph fidelity, airbrush-smooth transitions, razor speculars, shallow depth of field.
description_zh: 照相写实：绘画级照片保真、气笔般平滑过渡、锐利高光、浅景深。

description_en: Superflat: unmodulated color fields, thin even outlines, figure and pattern on one plane, deliberate depthlessness.
description_zh: 超扁平：无明暗色域、均匀细线、人物与纹样同一平面、刻意取消纵深。

description_en: Rococo: feathery pastel brush, powder pinks and celadon, shell-scroll ornament, airy high-key silk light.
description_zh: 洛可可：羽毛般粉彩笔触、粉红与青瓷色、贝壳涡卷纹样、高调丝绸光。

description_en: Mannerism: elongated elegant proportions, figura serpentinata, acidic jewel color, enamel-like finish.
description_zh: 样式主义：拉长优雅比例、蛇形姿态、酸性宝石色、珐琅般细润。

description_en: Constructivism: diagonal geometry, red-black-white planes, industrial cut shapes, agitprop poster construction.
description_zh: 构成主义：斜向几何、红黑白色块、工业切割形、鼓动海报构成。

description_en: Symbolism: jewel dusk palette, mystic haze, poetic decorative rhythm, gold and deep violet.
description_zh: 象征主义：宝石暮色、神秘薄雾、诗意装饰节奏、金与深紫。

description_en: De Stijl: orthogonal black grid, primary red yellow blue plus neutrals, flat neoplastic rectangles.
description_zh: 风格派：正交黑格、红黄蓝加中性色、平坦新造型色块。

description_en: Suprematism: floating squares and bars, limited black-white-red-yellow-blue, flat non-illusionistic planes.
description_zh: 至上主义：漂浮方块与色条、黑白红黄蓝限定色、平坦非幻觉色面。

description_en: Vorticism: angular machine-age shards, diagonal vortex geometry, khaki-steel-crimson facets.
description_zh: 漩涡主义：机械时代棱角碎片、斜向漩涡几何、卡其钢色与绯红切面。

description_en: Rayonism: intersecting prismatic light-rays, crossed colored beams, forms dissolved into radiating energy.
description_zh: 射线主义：交叉棱镜光射线、彩色光束叠穿、形体溶解为放射能量。

description_en: Precisionism: razor-sharp industrial geometry, smooth airbrushed planes, cool daylight cylinders and cubes.
description_zh: 精确主义：锋利工业几何、光滑喷绘色面、冷日光圆柱与立方体。

description_en: Orphism: simultaneous contrasting color disks, circular chromatic rhythms, prismatic translucent orbs.
description_zh: 俄耳甫斯主义：同时对比色环、圆形色彩节奏、半透明棱镜色盘。

description_en: Nabis: flattened decorative interiors, wallpaper arabesques, pattern-over-perspective, muted jewel tapestry color.
description_zh: 纳比派：平坦装饰室内、壁纸蔓纹、图案压过透视、沉宝石挂毯色。

description_en: Baroque: theatrical diagonals, swirling drapery, saturated crimson-gold umber, raking volumetric oil light.
description_zh: 巴洛克：戏剧斜向构图、翻卷织物、饱和绯红金赭、侧光体积油画。

description_en: Vienna Secession: geometric gold-leaf mosaic, square trees and spirals, black-gold-teal enamel fields.
description_zh: 维也纳分离派：几何金箔镶嵌、方树与螺旋纹、黑金青绿珐琅色域。

description_en: Bauhaus: primary red-yellow-blue plus black, overlapping circles triangles rectangles, workshop stage geometry.
description_zh: 包豪斯：红黄蓝加黑、交叠圆三角矩形、作坊舞台几何。

description_en: Purism: machine-smooth cylinders and planes, cool grey-ochre volumes, closed contours, no Cubist shatter.
description_zh: 纯粹主义：机械光滑圆柱与色面、冷灰赭体积、闭合轮廓、无立体碎裂。

description_en: Romanticism: sublime storm-light, tiny figure against nature, ochre-slate oils, scumbled mist.
description_zh: 浪漫主义：崇高风暴光、人小于自然、赭灰油彩、擦涂薄雾。

description_en: Pre-Raphaelite: jewel local color, enamel finish, hyper-clear botany, medievalizing costume.
description_zh: 前拉斐尔派：宝石固有色、珐琅般罩染、极清植物、中世纪化服饰。

description_en: Color Field: soaked unmodulated hue planes, soft blooming edges, stain on canvas weave.
description_zh: 色域绘画：浸泡无调制色面、柔边晕开、画布织纹染色。

description_en: Tachisme: lyrical stains, spatters, calligraphic blobs, chance pours, canvas ground showing.
description_zh: 塔希主义：抒情渍斑、飞溅、书法式色块、偶然倾倒、画布底显露。

description_en: Synchromism: color as musical scale, prismatic wheels, form built from spectral chords.
description_zh: 同步色彩主义：色彩如音阶、棱镜色轮、形体由光谱和弦构成。

description_en: Neoclassicism: enamel-smooth oil, marble ivory-slate palette, sculptural contour, calm pyramidal staging.
description_zh: 新古典主义：珐琅般平滑油彩、象牙石板色、雕塑轮廓、冷静金字塔构图。

description_en: Hard-Edge: unmodulated acrylic planes, razor color boundaries, large geometric fields, no visible brush.
description_zh: 硬边绘画：无调制丙烯色面、锐利色界、大几何色域、不见笔触。

description_en: Metaphysical Painting: long piazza shadows, empty arcade, ochre plaster, deep ultramarine sky, eerie stillness.
description_zh: 形而上绘画：广场长影、空廊、赭色灰泥、深蓝天空、诡静。

description_en: Post-Impressionism: constructive planes, cloisonné outline, directional loaded strokes, saturated local hue.
description_zh: 后印象派：建构色面、景泰蓝式勾线、定向厚笔、饱和固有色。

description_en: Action Painting: drip fling pour enamel, all-over skeins, raw canvas, overlapping black-white-cadmium gesture.
description_zh: 行动绘画：滴洒倾倒磁漆、满幅色线、裸画布、黑白镉黄交叠动势。

description_en: Plakatstil: reductive Sachplakat lithography, unmodulated ink fields, cream paper, silhouette-first, no gradient or halftone.
description_zh: 实物海报：减法式商业石版、无调制色面、乳色纸、剪影优先、无渐变网点。

description_en: Hyperrealism: enamel-smooth oil hiding brush, pore-scale skin, colder-than-photo clarity, counted fabric weave, studio speculars.
description_zh: 超写实主义：隐笔珐琅油彩、毛孔级皮肤、冷于照片的清晰、织物经纬可数、工作室高光。

description_en: CoBrA: primal childlike contour, violent primary slabs, thick impasto, raw canvas, spontaneous folk-brutal gesture.
description_zh: 眼镜蛇画派：原始稚拙轮廓、猛烈原色块、厚堆颜料、裸画布、即兴民俗暴烈笔势。

description_en: Neue Sachlichkeit: cold unsentimental contour, glassy enamel skin, hard local color, clinical daylight, veristic stillness.
description_zh: 新客观主义：冷硬无情轮廓、玻璃珐琅肤色、硬固有色、临床日光、写实静凝。

description_en: Japonisme: Western oil absorbing ukiyo-e space — high horizon, decorative pattern fields, cropped screens and fans, gold-leaf accents.
description_zh: 日本主义：西方油彩吸收浮世绘空间——高视平、装饰纹样色域、裁切屏风扇面、金箔点缀。

description_en: Dada: photomontage collage, torn newsprint, chance juxtaposition, glue-seam shadows, anti-academic cut paper.
description_zh: 达达主义：照相蒙太奇拼贴、撕裂新闻纸、偶然并置、胶缝阴影、反学院剪贴。

description_en: Minimalism: extreme reduction, unmodulated color slabs, hard anonymous edges, vast negative space, industrial calm.
description_zh: 极简主义：极度减法、无调制色面、匿名硬边、大片负空间、工业静默。

description_en: Der Blaue Reiter: prismatic spiritual color, stained-glass chords of blue yellow magenta, rhythmic contour, musical landscape.
description_zh: 青骑士：棱镜式精神色彩、蓝黄品红的彩窗和弦、节奏轮廓、音乐性风景。

description_en: Kano School: mineral color on gold-leaf screen, ink outline with controlled wash, pine and gold clouds, folding-panel space.
description_zh: 狩野派：金地矿物彩、控墨勾勒晕染、松树金云、折叠屏风空间。

description_en: International Gothic: enamel-bright tempera, tooled gold leaf, elongated courtly S-curve, jewel local color, patterned brocade.
description_zh: 国际哥特：珐琅亮蛋彩、压印金箔、修长宫廷S形、宝石固有色、织锦纹样。

description_en: Die Brücke: angular crude contour, clashing primaries, flattened city planes, woodcut-influenced jagged brush, raw German Expressionist slab.
description_zh: 桥社：棱角粗轮廓、冲突原色、压扁街景平面、木刻感锯齿笔触、德国表现主义生猛色块。

description_en: Synthetism: large unmodulated symbolic color planes, heavy enclosing contour, memory-hue not observed-hue, decorative flattening.
description_zh: 综合主义：大块无调制象征色面、闭合粗轮廓、记忆色而非写生色、装饰性压平。

description_en: Gutai: paint as material event — flung enamel, torn kraft, thick gel ridges, raw canvas, process footprints over depiction.
description_zh: 具体派：颜料即物质事件——甩泼磁漆、撕裂牛皮纸、厚凝胶脊、裸画布、过程足迹压过描绘。

description_en: Plein Air: on-site outdoor oil, wet-into-wet daylight, true sun-shadow temperature, portable-easel atmosphere painted from life.
description_zh: 外光写生：现场户外油彩、湿接湿日光、真实冷暖光影、便携画架对景气氛。

description_en: Chinoiserie: 18th-c European fantasy of China — willow-pattern cobalt, lacquer cinnabar, gold lattice, pagoda silhouettes, porcelain ornament.
description_zh: 中国风装饰：十八世纪欧洲幻想东方——青花柳纹钴蓝、朱红漆地、金格、宝塔剪影、瓷绘纹样。

description_en: Abstract Expressionism: New York School action painting — flung enamel drips, loaded-brush slashes, stained raw canvas, overlapping color storms.
description_zh: 抽象表现主义：纽约画派行动绘画——甩泼磁漆滴流、饱蘸笔触劈砍、生画布渗染、层层色暴。

description_en: Art Brut: raw outsider paste — gouged asphalt textures, crude contour, earth ochres and soot, untrained hatching in thick matter.
description_zh: 原生艺术：粗粝局外人厚浆——刮凿沥青肌理、生拙轮廓、土赭与煤黑、未驯排线堆料。

description_en: Streamline Moderne: 1930s aerodynamic design — chrome tubular rails, teardrop forms, ocean-liner white and pale aqua, rounded machine-age smoothness.
description_zh: 流线型现代：一九三〇年代空气动力学造型——铬管栏杆、泪滴体、邮轮白与浅水色、圆角机械时代光洁。

description_en: Dansaekhwa: Korean monochrome — layered off-white and umber, paint pushed and grooved into hanji, meditative tactile ridges, almost no chroma.
description_zh: 单色画：韩国单色绘画——层层灰白与赭褐、颜料推刮入韩纸、冥想触感棱脊、近乎无彩。

description_en: High Renaissance: Raphael/Leonardo school — pyramidal balance, unified perspective, atmospheric distance, classical architecture, oil-on-panel glaze.
description_zh: 盛期文艺复兴：拉斐尔与达芬奇一系——金字塔构图、统一透视、空气远景、古典建筑、木板油釉罩染。

description_en: Dutch Golden Age: 17th-century Holland oil — north-window daylight, quiet interiors, leaded glass, fine glaze on linen and pewter, genre-scene naturalism.
description_zh: 荷兰黄金时代：十七世纪荷兰油画——北窗日光、静室内景、铅条玻璃、亚麻与锡器细釉、风俗场景写实。

description_en: Magic Realism: crystal daylight, enamel-smooth oils, heightened local color, still air, one quiet impossibility treated as ordinary fact.
description_zh: 魔幻现实主义：水晶日光、珐琅般平滑油彩、强化固有色、静止空气、把一处安静的不可能当作日常。

description_en: Pixel Art: visible square pixels, limited palette, ordered dithering, hard-edged 16-bit sprite silhouettes, no painterly gradients.
description_zh: 像素艺术：可见方像素、有限色板、有序抖动、硬边十六位精灵轮廓、无绘画渐变。

description_en: Mughal miniature: jewel opaque watercolor, fine squirrel-hair line, floral gold border, shallow garden space, observed plants, court atelier paper.
description_zh: 莫卧儿细密画：宝石般不透明水彩、松鼠毫细线、花卉金边、浅园景空间、写生草木、宫廷作坊纸本。

description_en: Zhostovo: black lacquer tray painting — one-stroke peonies in pink, red and gold, metallic scrollwork, glossy varnish blooms on a void ground.
description_zh: 若斯托沃漆画：黑漆托盘绘画——一笔牡丹粉红赤金、金属卷草、亮漆高光花簇铺满虚空底。

description_en: Shan Shui: ink-and-wash landscape — hemp-fiber cun, misted mountain layers, empty-space water, mineral blue-green on silk.
description_zh: 山水：水墨山水——披麻皴、云雾层峦、留白江水、石青石绿绢本。

description_en: Naïve art: flattened sincere perspective, oversized foliage, shadowless local color, meticulous childlike outline.
description_zh: 稚拙艺术：平面真诚透视、巨大花叶、无影固有色、细密稚拙轮廓。

description_en: Psychedelia: 1960s poster swirl — molten contours, paisley optics, high-chroma complementary clash, blacklight neon inks.
description_zh: 迷幻艺术：六十年代海报涡旋——熔融轮廓、佩斯利视幻、高饱和补色对撞、黑光霓虹墨。

description_en: Ashcan School: urban realist oil — slashing dark brush, sooty brown-olive-slate, wet tenement street, unvarnished city light.
description_zh: 垃圾箱画派：都市写实油画——挥砍暗笔、煤褐橄榄石板色、湿漉贫民街、不加粉饰的城市光。

description_en: Hudson River School: American romantic landscape oil — luminous vast sky, meticulous wilderness, glowing atmospheric perspective.
description_zh: 哈德逊河画派：美国浪漫风景油画——浩瀚发光天空、精细荒野、辉映空气透视。

description_en: Barbizon School: mid-19th-century French plein-air oil — earthy olive-umber tonal brush, muddy woodland path, overcast silvery sky.
description_zh: 巴比松画派：十九世纪中叶法国外光油画——橄榄褐土色调笔、泥泞林径、银灰阴天。

description_en: Northern Renaissance: Early Netherlandish oil glaze — jewel local color, microscopic interior detail, crisp drapery, luminous leaded-window light.
description_zh: 北方文艺复兴：早期尼德兰罩染油画——宝石固有色、室内微观细节、锋利衣褶、铅条窗辉光。

description_en: Ottoman miniature: flat gold ground, high viewpoint, jewel lapis-vermilion-malachite, fine contour, patterned architecture, no Western perspective.
description_zh: 奥斯曼细密画：平涂金地、高视点、青金石朱红孔雀石、细线轮廓、图案建筑、无西方透视。

description_en: Palette knife: sculptural oil slabs, visible knife ridges and facets, broken color planes, almost no brush hair, tactile scraped impasto.
description_zh: 刮刀厚涂：雕塑般油彩块面、可见刀脊棱面、破碎色块、几乎无笔毫、可触刮痕厚涂。

description_en: Neo-Expressionism: 1980s loaded brush, raw contour, acidic chroma clash, crude figuration, heavy paint skin, urban studio grit.
description_zh: 新表现主义：八十年代饱蘸笔触、生硬轮廓、酸性高饱和对撞、粗放造型、厚颜料皮、都市画室粗粝。

description_en: Byzantine icon: egg tempera on gessoed panel, punchwork gold-leaf halo, reverse perspective, chrysography, hieratic flattened space, craquelure gold ground.
description_zh: 拜占庭圣像：石膏地蛋彩、錾金光环、反向透视、描金高光、圣像式扁平空间、金地龟裂。

description_en: Mexican Muralism: monumental buon fresco, earth-red indigo ochre masses, sculptural simplified volumes, plaster tooth, public-wall scale.
description_zh: 墨西哥壁画：巨幅湿壁画、土红靛蓝赭石色块、雕塑般简化体量、灰泥齿面、公共墙面尺度。

description_en: Delftware: cobalt underglaze on white tin glaze, blue-and-white only, baroque floral borders, tin-glaze crazing, fired ceramic sheen.
description_zh: 代尔夫特蓝陶：白锡釉钴蓝釉下彩、仅蓝白、巴洛克花卉边饰、锡釉开片、窑烧釉光。

description_en: Pop Surrealism: lowbrow enamel-smooth oil, porcelain skin, candy chroma against uncanny miniatures, velvet-dark ground, hyper-clean edges.
description_zh: 波普超现实：低俗艺术珐琅般平滑油彩、瓷感皮肤、糖果色对照诡异微缩物、丝绒暗底、超净边缘。

description_en: Quilling: coiled teardrop and marquise paper filigree, dimensional strip relief, colored paper edges in raking light, no brush paint.
description_zh: 衍纸：卷曲泪滴与梭形纸丝、立体纸条浮雕、侧光下的彩纸切口、无笔触颜料。

description_en: Dunhuang mural: mineral pigment on cave plaster, malachite and azurite, cinnabar, flaking lime, Tang flying-ribbon line, oxidized black contour.
description_zh: 敦煌壁画：洞窟灰泥矿彩、石绿石青、朱砂、剥落石灰、唐飞天飘带线、氧化黑轮廓。

description_en: American Regionalism: smooth enamel-like oil, hard rounded volumes, stylized rolling farmland, 1930s American Scene mural rhythm.
description_zh: 美国地方主义：珐琅般平滑油彩、硬边浑圆体量、风格化起伏农田、三十年代美国风土壁画节奏。

description_en: Yōga: Meiji–Taishō Western-style oil on canvas, academic bristle marks, plein-air flesh, Japanese subject in European oil method, not Nihonga.
description_zh: 洋画：明治大正西式油画、学院派笔触、外光肤色、以欧洲油彩画日本题材、非日本画矿彩。

description_en: Tingatinga: household enamel on masonite, saturated flat fill, bold black outline, glossy sunbursts and patterned fauna, Dar es Salaam studio painting.
description_zh: 廷加廷加：纤维板上的家用磁漆、饱和平涂、粗黑轮廓、亮泽日轮与纹样鸟兽、达累斯萨拉姆作坊绘画。

description_en: Manuscript illumination: egg tempera and burnished gold on vellum, historiated miniature, Insular knotwork and Gothic ivy borders, lapis and vermilion.
description_zh: 泥金写本：羊皮纸上的蛋彩与打磨金箔、故事性细密、海岛结饰与哥特常春藤边框、群青与朱红。

description_en: Chaekgeori: Joseon scholar-shelf still-life, stacked books and porcelain in shallow trompe-l'oeil cabinets, mineral pigments, slightly naive perspective.
description_zh: 册架图：朝鲜学者架静物、浅景深错视柜中的书卷与瓷器、矿物颜料、略带稚拙透视。

description_en: Qajar painting: 19th-century Persian court oil, large almond eyes, enamel-smooth flesh, floral textiles, tiled dado and lacquered palace interior.
description_zh: 卡扎尔绘画：十九世纪波斯宫廷油画、杏眼、珐琅般肤色、花卉织纹、瓷砖墙裙与漆光宫室。

description_en: Formline: Northwest Coast graphic system of swelling black formlines, ovoids, U-forms and trigons, red and turquoise tertiary fills, flattened cedar-panel space.
description_zh: 形线：西北海岸图形体系、鼓胀黑轮廓、卵形与U形三角、红与青绿填色、扁平杉板空间。

description_en: Academic Art: 19th-century salon académisme, invisible brushwork, porcelain-smooth flesh, staged chiaroscuro, classical drapery, enamel studio finish.
description_zh: 学院派：十九世纪沙龙学院主义、隐笔触、瓷滑肤色、经营明暗、古典披帛、珐琅般工作室完成面。

description_en: Ndebele mural: South African house-wall geometry, thick black bounds, flat unmodulated color fields, nested rectangles and chevrons, no shading.
description_zh: 恩德贝勒壁画：南非宅墙几何、粗黑界线、无调平涂色块、嵌套矩形与人字纹、无明暗。

description_en: Ajanta mural: mineral tempera on cave plaster, fluid dark contour, elongated lotus eyes, earth ochre-red-green palette, flaking narrative registers.
description_zh: 阿旃陀壁画：洞窟灰泥矿物颜料、流畅深色轮廓、细长莲目、土黄红绿调、剥落叙事分层。

description_en: Kangra miniature: Pahari wasli painting, hair-thin lyrical outline, malachite greens and lotus pinks, jewel-like local color, pastoral lyricism without heavy shadow.
description_zh: 康格拉细密画：帕哈里纸本、发丝游丝描、孔雀石绿与莲粉、珠宝般固有色、田园抒情而无重影。

description_en: Lubok: Russian popular woodcut, thick carved black outlines, flat unshaded red-yellow-green-blue fills, naive folk composition and woodgrain.
description_zh: 卢博克：俄罗斯民间木刻、粗黑刻线、红黄绿蓝平涂无明暗、稚拙构图与木纹。

description_en: Rosemaling: Norwegian folk panel painting, C and S scrolls, teardrop leaves and stylized roses in red-blue-green-gold on a decorated ground.
description_zh: 挪威玫瑰绘：民间板绘、C/S卷草、泪滴叶与程式玫瑰、红蓝绿金铺满装饰地。

description_en: Intimism: figure dissolved into wallpaper and upholstery, tapestry-like broken color, close domestic interior, muted glowing pattern-as-space.
description_zh: 私密主义：人物溶入墙纸与织物纹样、织锦般碎笔、近距室内、低饱和发光的纹样即空间。

description_en: Fileteado: Buenos Aires ornamental enamel, thick black contour ribbons, acanthus spirals, gold-crimson-green varnish, bird-and-flower cartouches.
description_zh: 菲莱特阿多：布宜诺斯艾利斯招牌彩绘、粗黑轮廓缎带、茛苕涡卷、金红绿亮漆、鸟花圆框。

description_en: Rarrk: Arnhem Land fine-line infill, parallel ochre hatching on bark-brown ground, flattened figure-ground, mineral red-yellow-white-black.
description_zh: 拉尔克：阿纳姆地细线填绘、赭石平行排线覆树皮褐地、平面图形、矿物红黄白黑。

description_en: Cuzco School: Andean colonial painting, gold-leaf brocade ground, flattened perspective, opaque tempera color, linear folds and floral punchwork.
description_zh: 库斯科画派：安第斯殖民绘画、金箔织锦地、平面透视、不透明蛋彩、线描衣褶与花卉錾金。

description_en: Lingnan School: modern Cantonese ink-and-color, wet-into-wet mineral washes, bone-line with splash-color, moist atmosphere and lively empty space.
description_zh: 岭南画派：近代粤派彩墨、湿撞矿物色、骨法与泼彩、润泽气氛与活空白。

description_en: Fraktur: Pennsylvania German folk illumination, fractured blackletter, compass tulips and distelfink birds, flat gouache on cream laid paper.
description_zh: 弗拉克图尔：宾州德裔民间彩饰、断裂黑体字、圆规郁金香与蓟雀、乳色纸上平涂水粉。

description_en: Tosa School: Yamato-e court painting, mineral pigments on gold-leaf paper, iron-wire outline, kasumi gold-mist bands, flattened stacked space.
description_zh: 土佐派：大和绘宫廷绘画、金地矿物色、铁线描、霞带金雾、平面叠景。

description_en: Hague School: 19th-century Dutch tonal oil, muted gray-green atmosphere, silvery overcast light, low-chroma broken brush, quiet wet sky.
description_zh: 海牙画派：十九世纪荷兰调性油画、灰绿低彩、银灰阴天光、克制笔触与湿润天空。

description_en: Bapo: Chinese trompe-l'oeil of torn relics — painted calligraphy scraps, foxed pages, seals and wormholes overlapping as broken-paper collage.
description_zh: 八破：残破字画的中国视错觉画、撕裂书页、印鉴虫洞、重叠纸屑的绘成拼贴。

description_en: Mola: Guna reverse-appliqué, stacked cotton layers with channel cut-outs, nested geometric fillers, high-chroma cloth plane, stitched slit edges.
description_zh: 莫拉：库纳反向贴花、多层棉布开槽露色、几何填缝、高饱和布面与缝边。

description_en: Zenga: Zen ink painting, bold spontaneous sumi, spare empty space, calligraphic brush personality, abbreviated lively figure and a small red seal.
description_zh: 禅画：禅僧水墨、大胆即兴焦墨、大片留白、书法性笔意、简笔人物与小朱印。

description_en: Maruyama-Shijō: Kyoto naturalistic painting after Maruyama Ōkyo — observed-from-life modeling, soft mineral color, ink that yields to wash, unidealized flora and light.
description_zh: 圆山四条派：圆山应举一系京都写生、对物写生造型、淡矿物色、墨线让位于晕染、不理想化的草木与光。

description_en: Company School: Indo-British hybrid watercolor — thin washes on pale paper, meticulous outline, documentary clarity, Mughal finish fused with botanical-watercolor modeling.
description_zh: 公司画派：印英混合水彩、浅纸薄染、细线勾勒、纪实清晰、莫卧儿细工与植物水彩造型的融合。

description_en: Phad: Rajasthani narrative cloth painting — mineral reds yellows greens on warm cloth, bold folk outline, flattened registers, decorative borders, horizontal storytelling density.
description_zh: 帕德画：拉贾斯坦叙事布画、暖布上的矿物红黄绿、粗黑民艺线、扁平分栏、装饰边框与横向叙事密度。

description_en: Wu School: Ming Suzhou literati painting after Shen Zhou — dry pale ink, scholar-amateur brush, understated hills and sparse trees, quiet voids, calligraphic texture strokes.
description_zh: 吴门画派：沈周一系明代苏州文人画、干淡墨、士人笔意、含蓄丘壑疏树、留白与书法性皴擦。

description_en: Kamasan: classical Balinese temple painting — wayang-derived profiles, ochre-red-black-gold, dense patterned ground, hierarchical flat space, fine black contour.
description_zh: 卡玛桑：巴厘古典寺庙绘画、瓦扬派生侧脸、赭红黑金、密纹地、等级化平面空间与细黑轮廓。

description_en: Zhe School: Ming professional landscape after Dai Jin — vigorous axe-cut cun, wet-into-dry ink, dramatic pines on jagged cliffs, strong black-gray hierarchy.
description_zh: 浙派：戴进一系明代职业山水、斧劈皴、湿干互破墨、危崖劲松、黑灰层次分明。

description_en: Pont-Aven School: late-1880s Breton Synthetist painting — unmodulated color fields, dark cloisonné contour, flattened space, gold-ochre emerald vermilion cobalt.
description_zh: 阿旺桥画派：1880年代末布列塔尼综合主义、平涂色块、景泰蓝式深轮廓、压平空间、金赭翠绿朱红钴蓝。

description_en: Basohli miniature: early Pahari painting — hot mineral pigments, mustard or red ground, beetle-wing green, large lotus-petal eyes, flat decorative architecture.
description_zh: 巴索利细密画：早期帕哈里绘画、热性矿物色、芥黄或红地、甲虫翅绿、莲瓣大眼、扁平装饰建筑。

description_en: Peredvizhniki: 19th-c Russian Wanderers oil — Repin/Levitan naturalism, earthy ochres and cool greys, birch-and-river outdoor light, visible painterly brushwork.
description_zh: 巡回画派：十九世纪俄国巡回展览派油画、列宾列维坦写实、土赭与冷灰、白桦河岸外光、可见笔触。

description_en: Namban: Momoyama Nanban-e folding-screen painting — gold-leaf ground, mineral pigments, gold clouds, Portuguese-era ships in Japanese byobu language.
description_zh: 南蛮绘：桃山南蛮屏风、金箔地、矿物颜料、金云、以日本屏风语汇画葡萄牙时期船舶。

description_en: Trecento gold-ground tempera, punchwork halos, Gothic folds, jewel local color.
description_zh: 十四世纪金地蛋彩、打制光环、哥特衣褶、宝石固有色。

description_en: Topographic city view, ruled perspective, luminous sky, glassy canal masonry.
description_zh: 城市实景、精确透视、澄明天空、玻璃般运河砌石。

description_en: Romano-Egyptian encaustic on wood, wax bloom, large catchlit eyes, linen clavus.
description_zh: 罗马埃及木板蜡画、蜡霜、大眼高光、亚麻镶边袍。

description_en: Malian mudcloth, fermented mud on cotton, graphic resist geometry, bone-and-earth.
description_zh: 马里泥染布、发酵泥绘棉、图形防染几何、骨白与土褐。

description_en: Danish coastal naturalism, silver-blue North Sea light, broken plein-air strokes.
description_zh: 丹麦海岸自然主义、银蓝北海光、外光碎笔。

description_en: Architectural capriccio: invented ruin-cities, mixed monuments, theatrical sky, oil staffage — fantasy veduta, not topography.
description_zh: 建筑奇想风景：虚构废墟城、混搭古迹、戏剧性天空、油画点景——幻想实景而非实测地形。

description_en: Venetian colorito oil: glazed crimson and gold, luminous flesh, painterly edges, lagoon light — Titian/Veronese handling.
description_zh: 威尼斯色彩主义油画：朱红金箔罩染、肌肤辉光、松动笔边、泻湖光线——提香/委罗内塞笔法。

description_en: Group of Seven landscape: bold simplified masses, rhythmic contour, decorative post-impressionist wilderness color.
description_zh: 七人画派风景：大胆简化体块、节奏轮廓、装饰性后印象派旷野色彩。

description_en: Danube School forest: feathery foliage, nature swallowing the figure, crag castle, Altdorfer woodland atmosphere.
description_zh: 多瑙河画派森林：羽状树叶、自然吞没人物、峭壁城堡、阿尔特多费尔林地氛围。

description_en: Multi-layer stencil graffiti: hard-edged spray, misregistration, drips, wheatpaste wall, high-contrast plates.
description_zh: 多层镂版涂鸦：硬边喷绘、套版错位、滴流、墙贴纸边、高对比色版。

description_en: Meiji–Taishō kuchi-e woodblock frontispiece: mica ground, bokashi plates, thin key-block, floral cartouche.
description_zh: 明治大正口绘木版：云母底、晕染色版、细墨线主版、花卉装饰框。

description_en: Song Mi-dot cun: stacked wet horizontal ink dots, blunt stippled mountains, humid blotting, no linear contour.
description_zh: 宋代米点皴：横点积墨、圆钝点皴山体、湿墨晕化、不以线勾轮廓。

description_en: Dada/Constructivist photomontage: scissor-cut photo shards, torn newsprint, glue shadows, diagonal scale jumps.
description_zh: 达达/构成主义摄影蒙太奇：剪刀切碎照片、撕裂新闻纸、胶痕阴影、斜向尺度跳跃。

description_en: Anamorphosis: extreme oblique stretch, floor-plane shear, perspective grid, cylindrical-mirror optical warp.
description_zh: 变形透视：极端斜向拉伸、地平面剪切、透视网格、柱面镜光学矫正。

description_en: Aerography airbrush: velvet spray gradients, masked soft edges, atomized pigment, overspray halo, no bristle strokes.
description_zh: 气刷喷绘：绒面喷雾渐变、遮罩软边、雾化颜料、过喷光晕、不见笔毫。

description_en: Heidelberg School Australian Impressionism: golden high-key sunlight, broken colour, square-brush plein-air oil, eucalyptus heat-haze.
description_zh: 海德堡画派澳大利亚印象主义：金色高调阳光、分离色彩、方笔外光油画、桉树热雾。

description_en: Cangiante: Renaissance hue-shift modeling, yellow-to-crimson drapery, green-to-red-violet, fresco luminosity, no blackened shadow.
description_zh: 换色法：文艺复兴换色塑形、黄转绯红衣褶、绿转红紫、湿壁画亮度、不以黑加深阴影。

description_en: Wildstyle graffiti: interlocking 3D letterforms, arrows and connections, chrome-candy fills, fat-cap highlights, brick-wall spray.
description_zh: 狂野涂鸦：交错立体字母、箭头连接、铬金糖果填色、粗喷头高光、砖墙喷绘。

description_en: Huichol yarn painting (nierika): densely pressed yarn mosaic, vivid fibre ridges, geometric sun-and-flower ornament, no brush paint.
description_zh: 惠乔尔纱画：密压纱线镶嵌、鲜艳纤维脊、几何日轮花卉纹样、不见笔触。

description_en: Brandywine School illustration: Pyle/Wyeth theatrical light, saturated earth-and-jewel oils, heroic Golden Age composition.
description_zh: 白兰地酒画派插画：派尔/怀斯剧场光、饱和大地与宝石油画、黄金时代英雄构图。

description_en: Nazarene Movement painting: fresco-like tempera clarity, Perugino-linear contour, enamel local color, limestone cloister light.
description_zh: 拿撒勒画派：湿壁画般的蛋彩清晰度、佩鲁吉诺式线描、珐琅本地色、石灰石回廊光。

description_en: Düsseldorf School oil: highly finished academic glaze, theatrical cloud architecture, staged narrative landscape light.
description_zh: 杜塞尔多夫画派油画：高度完成的学院罩染、戏剧性云层结构、舞台化叙事风景光。

description_en: Newlyn School naturalism: square-brush oil, silvery Cornish harbor daylight, wet cobbles, pewter-and-ochre working-clothes values.
description_zh: 纽林画派自然主义：方头笔油画、康沃尔港湾银灰日光、湿石板路、锡灰与赭石劳动服明度。

description_en: Bengal School wash revival: transparent earth tempera, lyrical Ajanta-influenced line, umber-indigo-sage mist, reserved paper white.
description_zh: 孟加拉画派水洗复兴：透明土色蛋彩、阿旃陀影响的抒情线描、棕靛鼠尾草绿薄雾、留白纸地。

description_en: Glasgow Boys tonal oil: square-brush Scottish grey-green light, Whistler-Hague harmony, Japanese-print flattening in dress and foliage.
description_zh: 格拉斯哥男孩画派调性油画：方头笔苏格兰灰绿光、惠斯勒-海牙调和、服饰与树叶的日本版画平面化。

description_en: Dalle de verre slab glass: thick faceted colored dalles set in concrete ribs, fractured jewel edges, brutalist-sacred transmitted light.
description_zh: 厚片玻璃镶嵌：厚切彩色玻璃块嵌于混凝土肋，碎宝石棱边，粗野派圣光透射。

description_en: Newar paubha: mineral pigment on cotton, vermilion-gold-indigo, razor outline, lotus throne and aureole geometry distinct from Tibetan thangka.
description_zh: 尼瓦尔宝画：棉地矿物颜料、朱红金靛、利落勾线、莲座与背光几何，有别于藏式唐卡。

description_en: Haboku splashed-ink: explosive wet-on-wet pooling, abbreviated mountain-mist, flying spatters and a few defining dry strokes.
description_zh: 破墨：爆发性湿墨渗化、简笔山雾、飞溅墨点与数笔定形枯笔。

description_en: Thanjavur painting: 22k gold-foil gesso relief, glass-bead gem inlay, saturated mineral primaries on dark teak-like ground.
