description_zh: 坦焦尔画：22K金箔灰泥浮雕、玻璃珠宝石镶嵌、饱和矿物原色、深色柚木底。

description_en: Kinngait stonecut-stencil: bold flattened polar shapes, stone-cut edge, limited ochre-teal-black on white paper.
description_zh: 金盖特石刻套色：大胆平面极地形块、石刻刀口、赭石青绿黑限色白纸。

description_en: Cosmatesque marble inlay: porphyry discs, serpentine triangles, guilloche bands, white marble and gold tesserae, Cosmati pavement geometry.
description_zh: 科斯马蒂嵌石：斑岩圆盘、蛇纹石三角、绞丝带饰、白大理石与金嵌片、科斯马蒂地坪几何。

description_en: Deluxe Edo surimono woodblock: mica-sparkle ground, karazuri blind emboss, fine mineral color, small-edition poem-print craft without lettering.
description_zh: 江户摺物木版：云母闪光底、空摺浮凸、精细矿物色、私家诗笺工艺且无文字。

description_en: Kerala temple mural: laterite red and ochre, lampblack outline, fresco-secco on plaster, elongated eyes, ornamental jewelry as painted pattern.
description_zh: 喀拉拉神庙壁画：红土赭石、灯黑勾线、干壁画灰泥、修长眼型、饰件作图案而非实物。

description_en: Tiffany Favrile glass: molten iridescent luster, peacock oil-slick sheen, translucent art-nouveau volumes, gold-pink-teal blown-glass refraction.
description_zh: 蒂芙尼法夫莱玻璃：熔融虹彩金属光、孔雀油膜色泽、新艺术半透明体量、金粉青绿吹制折射。

description_en: Odisha patachitra: lampblack contour on cotton, flat mineral red-yellow-green-white, floral border registers, cloth-scroll painting craft.
description_zh: 奥里萨帕塔绘画：棉地灯黑勾线、平涂矿物红黄绿白、花边栏框、布卷轴画工艺。

description_en: Edo ukiyo-e woodblock: keyblock outlines, flat nishiki-e color, indigo-safflower-yellow on cream washi, bokashi sky, woodgrain in open fields.
description_zh: 江户浮世绘木版：主版墨线、锦绘平涂、蓝红黄乳色和纸、天空晕染、开敞处可见木纹。

description_en: Baroque quadratura: di sotto in sù painted architecture, foreshortened columns and vaults opening to sky, oil-on-plaster illusion.
description_zh: 巴洛克透视天顶画：仰视错视建筑、缩短柱式与开敞天顶、油彩灰泥幻象。

description_en: Affichiste décollage: ripped poster strata, torn edges, leftover type scraps, glue-stained urban layers.
description_zh: 撕贴海报层积：毛边揭层、残字碎片、胶渍与城市纸层，非干净拼贴。

description_en: Chinese zhongcai: opaque mineral malachite, azurite, cinnabar and gold on silk, heavy-color stacking, not light gongbi wash.
description_zh: 中国重彩：石绿石青朱砂与金箔厚叠绢上，矿物堆染，非浅淡工笔渲染。

description_en: Yoruba adire eleko: cassava-starch resist on indigo cloth, geometric and flora motifs, dye-bleed crackle, textile as picture.
description_zh: 约鲁巴阿迪勒染：木薯浆防染靛蓝布、几何花卉纹、渗色裂纹，布面即画面。

description_en: Painted vitreous enamel on copper: translucent jewel glazes, gold paillon, fired gloss and craquelure.
description_zh: 铜胎画珐琅：透明宝石釉、金箔衬、烧成光泽与釉裂。

description_en: South Indian court painting on gessoed cloth: vegetable dyes, low-relief gold, thin outline, no Tanjore gem bosses.
description_zh: 南印度宫廷布面画：植物颜料、浅浮雕金饰、细线，无坦焦尔宝石凸饰。

description_en: Bijapur–Golconda miniature: lilac-gold sky, elongated figure, jeweled textiles, flattened decorative space.
description_zh: 比贾布尔—戈尔康达细密画：紫金天空、修长人物、珠宝织物、平面装饰空间。

description_en: Oil mixed with cold beeswax: matte velvety scrape, broken color, no torch-fused encaustic gloss.
description_zh: 冷蜂蜡调油：哑光刮层、断色，无热蜡画熔烧光泽。

description_en: Romanesque mural: heavy contour, flattened hieratic space, ochre and terre-verte arcade, apse fresco-secco.
description_zh: 罗马式壁画：粗轮廓、平面圣像空间、赭石与绿土拱廊、半圆室干壁画。

description_en: Raised gesso relief on gilded panel, punch-dotted gold, bole-red wear, tempera over burnished leaf.
description_zh: 膏塑浮雕贴金、錾点金地、丹赭底露出、蛋彩覆于打磨金箔。

description_en: Korean architectural polychromy: five cardinal mineral pigments, floral meoricho, painted timber brackets.
description_zh: 韩国建筑彩绘：五方矿物色、头草莲纹、梁枋丹青。

description_en: Edo perspective woodblock: vanishing-point interiors, keyblock outlines, bokashi depth, baren grain.
description_zh: 江户浮绘：灭点透视室内、主版勾线、ぼかし纵深、马连纹理。

description_en: Moroccan soap-sealed lime plaster, mineral burnish, eggshell sheen, earth-oxide clouds.
description_zh: 摩洛哥皂封石灰泥、矿物抛光、蛋壳光泽、土氧化物云斑。

description_en: Leiden fine painting: porcelain-smooth oil glaze, microscopic detail, velvet interior light.
description_zh: 莱顿精细画：瓷滑油釉、显微细节、丝绒室内光。

description_en: Late-Edo Yokohama-school woodblock: aniline pigments, Western perspective, keyblock outlines, Prussian-blue harbor.
description_zh: 幕末横滨绘：苯胺颜料、西式透视、墨线主版、普鲁士蓝港景。

description_en: Tarbell–Paxton atelier oil: velvet window light, pearly half-tones, broken-color drapery, quiet interior.
description_zh: 塔贝尔—帕克斯顿室内油画：丝绒窗光、珍珠半调、碎色衣褶。

description_en: Shanghai School ink-and-color: calligraphic contour, malachite and cinnabar on wet xuan, bold Republican-era brush.
description_zh: 海派彩墨：书法用笔、石绿朱砂着生宣、民国式阔笔。

description_en: Chinese finger painting: nail-line contour, fingerprint wash, palm-smeared mist on absorbent paper.
description_zh: 指画：甲痕勾线、指纹晕墨、掌抹烟岚着生宣。

description_en: Fencai overglaze enamel: opaque rose-pink, lime and turquoise on glazed white ground, jewellike raised enamel.
description_zh: 粉彩：胭脂红、葱绿松石釉上彩、瓷白地宝石堆釉。

description_en: Biedermeier oil: porcelain-smooth enamel, pale parlor daylight, honeyed walnut furniture, precise bourgeois local color.
description_zh: 比德迈尔油画：瓷滑釉面、客厅淡日光、蜜色胡桃木家具、市民精确固有色。

description_en: Rajasthani court miniature: flat jewel gouache on wasli, thin red outline, almond-eye profile, palace architecture and gold.
description_zh: 拉杰普特宫廷细密画：宝石色不透明水彩、细红勾线、杏眼侧脸、宫殿与金饰。

description_en: Nagasaki-school woodblock: late-Edo nishiki-e, Chinese-influenced mineral color, keyblock outline, Dutch-trade-port flattening.
description_zh: 长崎绘：幕末锦绘、唐风矿物颜料、墨线主版、荷兰贸易港式平透视。

description_en: Hand-painted ukiyo-e on silk: mineral pigment and gold, calligraphic outline, no woodblock keyblock, nikuhitsu silk ground.
description_zh: 肉笔浮世绘：绢本矿物颜料贴金、书法式勾线、非木版套印。

description_en: Chenghua-style doucai: underglaze cobalt contour filled with thin overglaze iron-red, yellow, apple-green and aubergine on white porcelain.
description_zh: 成化斗彩：釉下青花勾线、釉上矾红黄苹果绿茄紫薄彩填瓷白地。

description_en: Tang three-color lead glaze: amber, leaf-green and cream pooling over terracotta earthenware, oxide spots, running drips.
description_zh: 唐三彩：琥珀黄、叶绿与乳白铅釉在陶胎上垂流积釉、氧化斑点。

description_en: Akan stamped cloth: dark vegetable-dye calabash stamps of Adinkra symbols in grid repeat on ochre handwoven cotton.
description_zh: 阿丁克拉：葫芦印模植物染料、阿丁克拉符号网格压印于赭黄手织棉布。

description_en: East Anglian Norwich School oil: muted grey-green marsh, silvery moist sky, restrained earth pigments, quiet Dutch-influenced English landscape.
description_zh: 诺里奇画派：灰绿湿地、银湿天空、克制土色、荷兰影响下的英国风景油画。

description_en: Mexican amate bark-paper painting: beaten fibrous ground, bold black contour, flat aniline folk color on visible bark texture.
description_zh: 阿马特树皮画：捶制树皮纸底、粗黑勾线、苯胺民间平涂、树皮纤维可见。

description_en: Camden Town Group interior oil: thick muted violet-brown-olive impasto, patterned wallpaper, dull sash-window daylight, London bedsit.
description_zh: 卡姆登镇画派：紫褐橄榄厚涂、壁纸室内、窗光阴沉、伦敦亭子间油画。

description_en: Ming–Kangxi wucai overglaze enamel on white porcelain: iron-red, yellow, green, underglaze cobalt, aubergine, thin contour, firing speckle.
description_zh: 五彩：白瓷上铁红、黄、绿、釉下青花与茄紫低温釉上彩、细线、窑斑。

description_en: Southern Song axe-cut texture stroke (fu pi cun): chopping angular ink facets on rock, wet mist, one-corner Ma-Xia composition, hemp paper.
description_zh: 斧劈皴：马夏一角、斧斫块面石纹、湿墨云气、麻纸。

description_en: School of Paris easel oil: earth reds, viridian, ivory black, thick cosmopolitan Montparnasse studio-cafe brush, 1910s–30s modernist figuration.
description_zh: 巴黎画派：土红翠绿象牙黑、蒙帕纳斯画室咖啡馆厚涂、一战前后世界主义人物油画。

description_en: Japanese emakimono handscroll: horizontal continuous space, suyari-gasumi gold cloud bands, mineral pigment and ink on paper, unrolling narrative.
description_zh: 绘卷：横向连续空间、霞引金云、岩彩与墨、展开式叙事手卷。

description_en: Mid-century St Ives School: pale limestone harbor light, sea-grey and ochre constructive planes, whitewashed Cornish studio, abstracted boats.
description_zh: 圣艾夫斯画派：石灰白港光、海灰与赭石构成块面、康沃尔粉墙、几何化渔船。

description_en: Scottish Colourists oil: Iona-white interiors, cadmium and cobalt planes, black-outlined still life, Fauvist-derived opaque blocks.
description_zh: 苏格兰色彩派：爱奥那白室内、镉黄与钴蓝色块、黑线静物、野兽派式不透明色面。

description_en: Fête galante: Watteau parkland rococo, silk-sheen pastel, feathery trees, pearly twilight, theatrical garden architecture.
description_zh: 游乐画：华托式园林洛可可、缎光粉彩、羽毛状林木、珍珠暮光、剧场化园景建筑。

description_en: Kakiemon overglaze: milky nigoshide white, sparse iron-red turquoise cobalt gold enamel, asymmetric empty porcelain space.
description_zh: 柿右卫门：乳白浊手底、疏朗铁红青绿钴蓝金彩、不对称留白瓷面。

description_en: Early Netherlandish oil: jewel glazes, north-window light, microscopic interior, convex-mirror clarity, van Eyck layered medium.
description_zh: 早期尼德兰：宝石釉层、北窗冷光、微观室内、凸镜般清晰、扬·凡·艾克层层罩染。

description_en: Hemp-fiber cun: long flexible pima strokes on rolling Jiangnan hills, Dong Yuan–Juran Southern School texture, wet layered ink.
description_zh: 披麻皴：长柔麻纤维皴纹覆江南丘壑、董源巨然南宗肌理、层层湿墨。

description_en: Fontainebleau School: 16th-century French Mannerist court painting, elongated elegance, enamel-cool porcelain flesh, sculptural satin drapery, grottesche stucco.
description_zh: 枫丹白露画派：十六世纪法国宫廷样式主义、修长优雅、珐琅冷瓷肌、雕塑感缎褶与怪诞灰塑。

description_en: Cretan School: post-Byzantine Italo-Cretan egg tempera on gold leaf, linear hierarchical folds, chrysography, punchwork gesso ground.
description_zh: 克里特画派：后拜占庭意克里特蛋彩金地、线性层褶、金线提亮与錾花石膏地。

description_en: Jinbi shanshui: gold-and-blue Chinese landscape, azurite-malachite peaks, gold-outline pavilions and clouds, mineral-pigment Tang–Song monumentality.
description_zh: 金碧山水：金碧设色青绿峰峦、金线楼阁云气、矿彩唐宋巨嶂。

description_en: Cheriyal painting: Telangana Nakashi narrative scroll, flat primaries, bold black contour, floral borders, red-earth ground, folk-tempera opacity.
description_zh: 切里亚尔绘画：特伦甘纳纳卡希叙事卷轴、平涂原色、粗黑轮廓、花边与红土地、民间不透明色。

description_en: Raindrop cun: short dense rain-spot texture strokes building Northern Song rock mass, millet-rain stipple, not hemp-fiber, axe-cut, or Mi-dot.
description_zh: 雨点皴：短密雨点皴纹堆北宋山石、粟雨点厾，非披麻、斧劈或米点。

description_en: Ox-hair cun: dense wiry overlapping texture strokes covering rock mass like ox hair, tighter than hemp-fiber, not axe-cut, raindrop, or Mi-dot.
description_zh: 牛毛皴：细密卷曲交叠的牛毛状皴纹覆山石，紧于披麻，非斧劈、雨点或米点。

description_en: Soak-stain: thinned pigment blooming into unprimed canvas weave as translucent veils, soft bleeds, no impasto or hard contour.
description_zh: 浸泡染色：稀释颜料渗入生画布织纹成半透明色晕，软渗边，无厚涂与硬轮廓。

description_en: Imari: Arita overglaze picture — underglaze cobalt, iron-red enamel, gilt brocade on white porcelain ground, not a ceramic-object product shot.
description_zh: 伊万里：有田上绘画面——釉下钴蓝、铁红珐琅与金彩锦地白瓷底，非瓷器静物产品照。

description_en: Iron-wire drawing: even-width unmodulated ink contours like drawn iron wire, no calligraphic swell, pale mineral wash on silk.
description_zh: 铁线描：粗细均匀如铁丝的墨线轮廓，无书法提按，绢上淡矿彩。

description_en: Kishangarh miniature: elongated lotus-petal eyes, arched brow, swan neck, jewel opaque watercolor on wasli, moonlit lake terrace.
description_zh: 基尚加尔细密画：修长莲瓣眼、高眉、鹅颈，不透明水彩于瓦斯利纸，月湖台榭。

description_en: Lotus-leaf cun: branching drying-lotus-leaf vein strokes forking across rock mass, reserved white cracks, not axe-cut, hemp-fiber, raindrop, or ox-hair.
description_zh: 荷叶皴：如干荷叶脉分叉的皴纹覆山石、留白裂纹，非斧劈、披麻、雨点或牛毛。

description_en: Mitsuda-e: Nara litharge-oil painting, mineral color under warm amber varnish film, slight crackle, not urushi lacquer or ukiyo-e ink line.
description_zh: 密陀绘：奈良密陀僧油绘，矿彩覆暖琥珀漆膜、微裂，非漆绘或浮世绘墨线。

description_en: Minai: Kashan overglaze enamel on tin-white glaze — turquoise, cobalt, iron-red, black contour, gold — pictorial field, not a ceramic-object product shot.
description_zh: 米奈彩绘：卡尚锡白釉上绘珐琅——青绿、钴蓝、铁红、黑线与金彩，画面铺满，非瓷器产品照。

description_en: Viscosity print: simultaneous-color intaglio, inks of different oil viscosity on one plate, offset rainbow blends, plate-tone and platemark, not screenprint or lithograph.
description_zh: 黏度套色版画：同一凹版上不同油性黏度油墨同时上色、虹彩叠印、版痕与版调，非丝网或石版。

description_en: Fahua: Ming raised-slip enamel picture — turquoise, cobalt, aubergine, mustard, white pools divided by cloison-like ridges, not metal cloisonné or wucai, not a jar product shot.
description_zh: 珐华：明代立粉珐琅画面——青绿、钴蓝、茄皮紫、姜黄与白釉被立线分隔，非掐丝珐琅或五彩，非罐子产品照。

description_en: Tihong: carved cinnabar lacquer — stacked vermillion-to-oxblood urushi, knife-cut floral and cloud relief, polished ridges over a black core, not painted polychrome or cloisonné, not a lacquer box product shot.
description_zh: 剔红：层层朱红至绛红漆再刀刻云花浮雕，高处抛光、深处见黑地，非彩绘或掐丝珐琅，非漆盒产品照。

description_en: Tenmoku: Jian ware iron glaze as picture — hare's-fur striations, oil-spot yohen metallic blooms, thick black-brown pooling and russet crystals, not celadon, not a tea-bowl product shot.
description_zh: 天目：建盏铁釉画面——兔毫、油滴曜变金属斑、厚黑褐釉积与赭晶，非青瓷，非茶碗产品照。

description_en: Jasperware: matte colored biscuit ground with applied white sprigged cameo relief, dry unglazed surface, not glossy porcelain or famille rose, not a vase product shot.
description_zh: 碧玉瓷：无光色地素烧上贴附白色浮雕贴花，干燥无釉表面，非亮釉瓷或粉彩，非花瓶产品照。

description_en: Kinma: incised lacquer with yellow, green, and red color filled into grooves on a dark polished ground, linear inlay, not maki-e gold sprinkling, not a box product shot.
description_zh: 蒟酱：深色抛光漆面阴刻后填入黄绿红彩漆，线槽嵌色，非莳绘洒金，非漆盒产品照。

description_en: Nashiji: pear-skin gold-flake lacquer — dense aventurine flakes in translucent amber urushi, sparkling polished ground, not solid kinpaku leaf, not a lacquer box product shot.
description_zh: 梨地：半透明琥珀漆中密布金屑如梨皮闪光，抛光漆面，非整张金箔，非漆盒产品照。

description_en: Unione: High Renaissance color blending — adjacent hues melt without contour, pearly fused midtones, Raphael-like dissolved edges, not hard outline, not sfumato smoke, not chiaroscuro.
description_zh: 融合法：盛期文艺复兴邻色无轮廓熔接，珍珠般中间调，拉斐尔式边缘消融，非硬线，非烟雾法，非明暗法。

description_en: Celadon: Longquan qingci glaze language — milky jade-green feldspathic skin, ice crackle, glaze pooling in recesses, carved low-relief under glassy celadon, pictorial field not a ware-as-object still life.
description_zh: 青瓷：龙泉青釉语言——乳浊青绿长石釉、冰裂纹、凹处积釉、釉下浅浮雕，画面技法而非器物静物。

description_en: Bargello: Florentine flame stitch — counted-thread wool chevrons, stepped color peaks, zigzag geometry as the whole picture, embroidery texture not a fashion title.
description_zh: 火焰绣：佛罗伦萨计针绒线人字折线，阶梯式色峰铺满画面，刺绣技法而非时装名。

description_en: Fresson Print: direct carbon color process — four-color pigment tissues, velvety matte paper, grainy pictorialist color, no silver gloss, powdery carbon surface.
description_zh: 弗雷松印相：直接碳素彩色工艺，四色颜料碳纸、丝绒哑光、颗粒画意色彩、无银盐反光。

description_en: Millefleur: late Gothic mille-fleurs tapestry ground — dense thousand-flower wool-silk weave on dark green, hatch-woven plants and herbs, flattened tapestry space, technique not a garden story.
description_zh: 千花锦地：晚期哥特千花挂毯底，深绿底密织无数小花草木，纬向羊毛纹理，扁平织造空间，技法而非花园叙事。

description_en: Folded-ribbon Cun: Northern landscape rock modeling with short angular ink strokes stacked like bent ribbons, dry-brush hemp-paper tooth, mist voids between cliff facets, texture-stroke not a travel story.
description_zh: 折带皴：北派山石以短折带状墨皴层层起面，枯笔麻纸齿感，崖面间留雾白，皴法而非行旅叙事。

description_en: Ziatype: palladium-like iron-oxalate printing-out process, matte paper, lavender-brown to eggplant-magenta split-tone, creamy highlights, no gelatin gloss.
description_zh: 齐亚型印相：类钯盐铁草酸晒印，哑光纸基，薰衣草棕至茄紫分调，乳白高光，无明胶光泽。

description_en: Crewel: Jacobean wool embroidery on slubbed linen, long-and-short and stem stitch, laid-and-couched nap, vegetable-dye greens golds russets, stitch texture not a fashion plate.
description_zh: 绉线绣：亚麻底雅可宾羊毛绣，长短针与轮廓针、铺钉绒面，草木染青绿金赭，针脚质感而非时装图。

description_en: Imprimatura: warm translucent earth ground (raw sienna / burnt umber) flashing through thin oil, dead-color masses, Venetian-Flemish underlayer, fat-over-lean, not finished porcelain realism.
description_zh: 有色底子：生赭/煅棕半透明油底从薄色中透出，死色团块，威尼斯—佛兰德斯底层，肥盖瘦，非瓷感完成写实。

description_en: Wiener Werkstätte: Vienna Workshop surface design, Hoffmann/Moser geometry, black-white-gold checkers and square florals, flat even contour, decorative plane not Klimt pastiche.
description_zh: 维也纳工坊：霍夫曼/莫泽几何平面，黑白金棋格与方块花卉，均匀平涂轮廓，装饰平面而非克里姆特仿作。

description_en: Shino: milky feldspar glaze fields, salmon fire-color, iron-red scorch freckles and pinholing as pictorial surface, not ceramic-as-object.
description_zh: 志野：乳浊长石釉面、火色橙红、铁红焦斑与针孔作为画面肌理，而非陶瓷器物静物。

description_en: Lustreware: tin-glaze lustre painting, copper-ruby and gold metallic film over cream glaze, Hispano-Moresque reduction sheen as picture skin.
description_zh: 虹彩釉：锡釉虹彩绘，铜红与金膜覆于乳白釉，伊斯帕诺-摩尔式还原金属光泽作为画面表皮。

description_en: Damascening: gold and silver wire inlay into darkened steel, Toledo/zougan arabesques as the drawing method, not jewelry-as-object.
description_zh: 错金银：金银丝嵌于暗钢，托莱多/象嵌卷草作为描法，而非首饰器物。

description_en: Kantha: Bengali running-stitch pictorial embroidery, parallel stitch fills on layered cotton ground, folk stitch rhythm not quilt-as-object.
description_zh: 康塔绣：孟加拉跑针作为画面描法，平行针填满层叠棉布底，民俗针步而非被子器物。

description_en: Cloud-head Cun: stacked curling cumulus-like yun-tou texture strokes of Chinese landscape, Northern Song rock vocabulary on silk.
description_zh: 云头皴：层叠卷曲如积云的皴法，北宋山石肌理施于绢素，而非泛化水墨渲染。

description_en: Unravelled-rope Cun: loosely twisted hemp-rope texture strokes of Chinese landscape, overlapping S-curves modeling rock and drapery on silk, Northern Song vocabulary not generic ink wash.
description_zh: 解索皴：松解麻绳般交叠的S形皴笔，以北宋山石语汇塑形于绢素，而非泛化水墨晕染。

description_en: Jun Ware: milky opalescent sky-blue transmutation glaze, copper-red flambé blooms, orange-peel and glaze runs as pictorial skin, not ceramic-as-object.
description_zh: 钧瓷：乳浊天蓝窑变釉、铜红窑变斑、橘皮与釉泪作为画面表皮，而非陶瓷器物静物。

description_en: Suzani: Central Asian chain-stitch and couching as the drawing method, palmette and pomegranate silk-floss field on cotton, folk stitch rhythm not textile-as-object.
description_zh: 苏扎尼：中亚锁链绣与钉线作为描法，石榴与棕叶纹丝线铺满棉底，民俗针步而非织物器物。

description_en: Argyrotype: iron-silver siderotype print, warm walnut-brown silver deposit on rag paper, faint iron stain, 19th-century printing-out look not cyanotype blue.
description_zh: 银铁印相：铁盐银影像，胡桃棕银粒沉于棉纤维纸，浅铁渍边，十九世纪晒印相貌而非蓝晒。

description_en: Kogin: Tsugaru kogin-zashi counted diamond running-stitch on indigo hemp, white cotton hishi lattice as the image method, not sashiko and not garment-as-object.
description_zh: 津轻菱刺：靛蓝麻底计针菱纹，白棉跑针构成画面，非刺子绣，亦非衣物器物。

description_en: Bizen: unglazed wood-fired Bizen surface as the image method—iron-rich toasted clay, goma ash speckles, hidasuki straw-scorch ribbons, kiln-scar flash; not celadon, not tenmoku, not pottery-as-object.
description_zh: 备前：以无釉柴烧土肌入画，铁红焦土、芝麻灰、火筋与窑变疤痕构成画面，非青瓷、非天目，亦非器物静物。

description_en: Sang-de-boeuf: Langyao copper-red flambé glaze as the image method—oxblood runs, liver pooling, peach-bloom breaks and gravity-flow vitreous streaks; not famille rose, not lustreware.
description_zh: 郎窑红：以铜红窑变釉入画，牛血红垂流、肝色积釉与豇豆红开片构成画面，非粉彩，亦非虹彩釉。

description_en: Hardanger: Norwegian whitework as the image method—kloster satin blocks, cutwork windows, woven bars and evenweave lattice; not sashiko, not kogin, not garment-as-object.
description_zh: 哈当厄尔绣：挪威抽纱白绣入画，克洛斯特缎针块、镂空窗格与编织杠构成画面，非刺子绣，非津轻菱刺，亦非衣物器物。

description_en: Nature Printing: Naturselbstdruck inked-plant impressions as the image method—vein-perfect plate-squash on rag paper, overlapping fern and leaf intaglio tone; not photogram, not gyotaku, not frottage.
description_zh: 自然印花：以实物转印入画，叶脉压痕、蕨类叠印与版调构成画面，非物影照片，非鱼拓，亦非拓印擦绘。

description_en: Devil-face Cun: gui-mian cun jagged rock-facet strokes as the image method—cleaved angular planes and dry-ink fractures of Northern Song monumentality; not ax-cut, not cloud-head, not hemp-fiber cun.
description_zh: 鬼面皴：以棱面如鬼脸的山石皴法入画，折裂块面与枯墨构成画面，非斧劈皴、非云头皴、非披麻皴。

description_en: Sinopia: fresco underdrawing as the image method—hematite and burnt-sienna brush on coarse lime arriccio, pounce-dots and construction arcs; not buon fresco color, not cartoon paper, not sanguine on rag.
description_zh: 湿壁画红土底：以湿壁画赭红底稿入画，赤铁矿笔触、粗灰泥齿面与刺孔构成画面，非完成湿壁画设色，非纸本草图，亦非红粉笔素描。

description_en: Steel Engraving: 19th-century steel-plate intaglio as the image method—burin parallels, flesh stipple, ruled sky tints and reserved paper-white highlights; not copper etching, not wood engraving, not mezzotint.
description_zh: 钢版雕刻：以十九世纪钢板凹版入画，雕刀平行线、肤面点刻与直尺天光构成画面，非铜版蚀刻，非木口木刻，亦非美柔汀。

description_en: Ivorytype: albumen photograph on imitation-ivory as the image method—translucent watercolor tint, creamy highlights and yellowed varnish bloom; not daguerreotype silver, not ambrotype, not opalotype.
description_zh: 象牙印相：以仿象牙底蛋白照片入画，薄水彩上色、乳色高光与发黄罩光构成画面，非达盖尔银版，非安布罗型，亦非乳白玻璃印相。

description_en: Rain-eroded Wall Cun: yulin qiangtou cun as the image method—vertical rain-guttered cliff planes and dry-ink water-stains like weathered rammed earth; not hemp-fiber, not ax-cut, not raindrop cun.
description_zh: 雨淋墙头皴：以垂直雨痕墙面皴法入画，淋漓石壁与枯墨水渍构成画面，非披麻皴、非斧劈皴、非雨点皴。

description_en: Dufaycolor: 1930s additive mosaic-screen color film as the image method—regular RGB réseau lines, muted primaries and film-base warmth; not Autochrome starch dots, not Kodachrome, not Cibachrome.
description_zh: 杜菲彩屏：以一九三零年代规则彩屏加色片入画，红绿蓝网线、柔和原色与片基暖调构成画面，非奥托克罗姆淀粉点，非柯达克罗姆，亦非西巴克罗姆。

description_en: Buncheong: Korean gray-green stoneware as the image method—white slip inlay and stamping, iron-brown underglaze brush, ash-glaze pooling; not celadon porcelain, not Cizhou, not Mishima, not Bizen.
description_zh: 粉青沙器：以高丽灰绿炻器入画，白化妆土镶嵌戳印、铁绘与灰釉积釉构成画面，非青瓷，非磁州，非三岛嵌，亦非备前。

description_en: Phulkari: Punjabi darned-stitch silk floss on khaddar as the image method—geometric floral lozenges, bagh-like fill, cloth ground as negative space; not kantha running stitch, not crewel, not hardanger, not suzani.
description_zh: 普尔卡里绣：以旁遮普粗棉上缎光丝线挑花入画，几何花菱与满铺巴格填针构成画面，非康塔走针，非绉线绣，非哈当厄尔，亦非苏扎尼。

description_en: Karatsu: Japanese tea-ware stoneware as the image method—iron-brown e-Karatsu brush, hakeme slip streaks, wood-ash crawl and kiln blush; not Bizen unglazed, not Shino feldspar white, not Oribe copper green, not Tenmoku.
description_zh: 唐津：以日本茶陶炻器入画，绘唐津铁绘、刷毛目白化妆与灰釉缩釉窑变构成画面，非备前裸烧，非志野长石白，非织部铜绿，亦非天目。

description_en: Scattered-firewood Cun: Chinese landscape texture of jagged crossed stick-like strokes as the image method—dry brush, flying-white splits, piled-twig ink; not axe-cut, not hemp-fiber, not unravelled-rope, not devil-face, not rain-eroded wall.
description_zh: 乱柴皴：以交错柴枝般的干笔皴法入画，飞白与叠枝墨线构成山石肌理，非斧劈皴，非披麻皴，非解索皴，非鬼面皴，亦非雨淋墙头皴。

description_en: Oil Print: Rawlins dichromated-gelatin oil process as the image method—greasy lithographic ink rolled into a gelatin matrix, velvety pigment grain, cream paper lights; not bromoil, not gumoil, not carbon print, not gelatin silver.
description_zh: 油彩印相：以罗林斯重铬酸盐明胶油墨工艺入画，油脂石版墨滚入胶膜、绒面色粉颗粒与乳白高光构成画面，非溴油，非树胶油彩印相，非碳印，亦非明胶银盐。

description_en: Cizhou: north-China stoneware painting as the image method—creamy white slip, bold black iron-oxide brushwork and sgraffito through slip to the grey body, folk-ceramic graphic contrast; not blue-and-white porcelain, not buncheong, not famille rose, not sometsuke.
description_zh: 磁州窑：以华北化妆土彩绘入画，乳白化妆土、铁绘黑彩与划花露胎构成画面，民间陶瓷的黑白对照，非青花瓷，非粉青沙器，非粉彩，亦非染付。

description_en: Alum-head Cun: Chinese landscape texture of clustered rounded boulder heads like alum crystals stacked on mountain crowns; not hemp-fiber cun, not ox-hair cun, not cloud-head cun, not raindrop cun, not mi-dot cun, not devil-face cun.
description_zh: 矾头皴：以山巅叠累如矾晶的浑圆石首入画，短裹轮廓聚成卵石颅顶，非披麻皴，非牛毛皴，非云头皴，非雨点皴，非米点皴，亦非鬼面皴。

description_en: Chikankari: Lucknow white-on-white shadow-work embroidery as the image method—bakhiya showing through muslin, phanda knots, murri, jaali openwork, barely-tonal white thread on airy cotton; not phulkari, not kantha, not crewel, not hardanger.
description_zh: 奇坎卡里白绣：以勒克瑙白上白影绣入画，透纱的巴基亚暗针、结粒、穆里与贾利镂空构成画面，非普尔卡里绣，非康塔绣，非绒线绣，亦非哈当厄尔绣。

description_en: Manière Criblée: dotted-manner metalcut as the image method—a punched metal plate of white dots on a black field, criblé sparkle and incised outline on cream laid paper; not mezzotint, not stipple engraving, not niello, not steel engraving, not generic metalcut.
description_zh: 密点金属凸版：以点刻法冲点金属凸版入画，白星铺满黑地、轮廓阴刻印在米色手抄纸上，非美柔汀，非点刻铜版，非乌银镶嵌，非钢版雕刻，亦非泛称金属凸版。

description_en: Kente: Ghanaian strip-woven cloth as the image method—narrow handwoven strips sewn into geometric weft blocks, silk-cotton sheen, gold-green-red-blue rectangles and chevrons; not adinkra stamp cloth, not bogolanfini, not ndebele mural, not kuba raffia.
description_zh: 肯泰织：以加纳窄幅条织入画，手工织条缝成几何纬块，丝棉光泽与金黄绿红蓝的矩形人字纹构成画面，非阿丁克拉印布，非博戈兰泥染，非恩德贝勒壁画，亦非库巴拉菲亚绒绣。

description_en: Hagi: Japanese Hagi-ware glaze as the image method—milky white-to-blush feldspathic pooling, fine kan'nyu crazing, warm pink-white satin skin and iron-specked clay rims; not raku, not shino crawl, not karatsu iron brush, not celadon.
description_zh: 萩烧：以萩釉入画，乳白带粉的长石釉积、细开片、柔粉白缎面与铁点胎土边，非乐烧，非志野缩釉，非唐津铁绘，亦非青瓷。

description_en: Kuba cloth: Congolese raffia cut-pile as the image method—tufted geometric diamonds, nested lozenges and chevrons in earth red, ochre, cream and brown-black; not kente strip-weave, not adinkra stamps, not bogolanfini, not ndebele mural.
description_zh: 库巴绒绣：以刚果库巴拉菲亚割绒入画，菱格套叠与人字纹的赭红米棕割绒触感，非肯泰条织，非阿丁克拉印布，非博戈兰泥染，亦非恩德贝勒壁画。

description_en: Rotogravure: copper-cylinder continuous-tone intaglio as the image method—microscopic ink cells, velvety warm-black to sepia magazine gravure, slight ink squash, no hard halftone dots; not photogravure dust-grain, not steel engraving, not collotype, not gelatin silver.
description_zh: 轮转凹版：以铜滚筒连续调凹印入画，微细着墨孔、丝绒暖黑到棕褐的杂志凹印与轻微溢墨，无硬网点；非照相凹版尘粒，非钢版雕刻，非珂罗版，亦非明胶银盐。

description_en: Rolling-cloud Cun: Northern Song 卷云皴 as the image method—curling comma-like volute rock strokes in the Guo Xi idiom, ink on silk, stacked spiral-cloud modeling; not cloud-head cun knobs, not hemp-fiber cun, not alum-head cun, not axe-cut cun.
description_zh: 卷云皴：以北宋卷云皴入画，郭熙式卷曲逗号状石纹、绢本水墨与层叠螺旋云体，非云头皴蘑菇结，非披麻皴，非矾头皴，亦非斧劈皴。

description_en: Zardozi: Mughal-Persian goldwork as the image method—raised couched gold and silver zari cords, bullion, sequins and pearls on silk; not or nué shaded gold needle-painting, not kesi tapestry, not chikankari whitework, not phulkari floss.
description_zh: 金线绣：以莫卧儿-波斯扎尔多齐金工入画，盘金银线、珠片与凸起金绳绣于丝绸，非晕金绣，非缂丝，非奇坎卡里白绣，亦非普尔卡里绣。

description_en: Kasuri: Japanese 絣 ikat-resist weaving as the image method—warp-and-weft splash patterns, indigo-and-white haze where dyed yarns misalign, feathered stepped geometry in the cloth; not Southeast Asian ikat, not shibori tie-dye, not aizome solid indigo, not batik.
description_zh: 絣织：以日本絣经纬防染织入画，靛蓝与本白溅纹、纱线错位形成的羽化几何与织纹雾边；非东南亚絣经纬织，非絞染，非纯蓝染，亦非蜡染。

description_en: Straw Marquetry: marqueterie de paille as the image method—split rye and wheat straw ribbons, knife-cut veneer panels, burnished gold-amber grain iridescence; not wood marquetry, not intarsia, not tessera mosaic, not paper quilling.
description_zh: 麦秆镶嵌：以麦秆细木镶嵌入画，剖开的黑麦与小麦秆条、刀切贴面与抛光金琥珀纹理闪光；非木材镶嵌，非细木镶嵌画，非马赛克，亦非衍纸。

description_en: Opus Anglicanum: English medieval underside-couched goldwork as the image method—spiraling gold grounds, silk split-stitch modeling, pearl couching on cope-dense embroidery; not or nué shaded gold needle-painting, not zardozi raised bullion, not stumpwork padding, not opus teutonicum whitework.
description_zh: 英格兰金绣：以中世纪英格兰背面钉金绣入画，螺旋金地、劈针丝线塑形与密铺珍珠钉线；非晕金绣，非扎尔多齐凸金绳，非垫绣，亦非条顿白绣。

description_en: Palampore: Coromandel painted palampore chintz as the image method—mordant-resist cotton, kalam-drawn outlines, flowering tree-of-life field, madder and indigo with chintz glaze; not kalamkari temple narrative, not toile de Jouy engraved toile, not ajrakh geometric blockprint, not pichwai shrine cloth.
description_zh: 帕兰波尔：以科罗曼德手绘帕兰波尔印花棉布入画，媒染防染、卡兰描线、生命之树花田与茜红靛蓝上光；非卡拉姆卡里神庙叙事，非茹伊印花铜版，非阿吉拉克几何木模，亦非皮切瓦伊神帐。

description_en: Luminogram: Moholy-Nagy cameraless light drawing as the image method—moving-light traces on photosensitive paper, overlapping white-to-silver beams, no lens; not photogram object-shadows, not chemigram chemical stains, not cliché-verre scratched glass, not lumen-print sun-faded botanicals.
description_zh: 光造影像：以莫霍利-纳吉无相机光绘入画，感光纸上的移动光迹、交叠银白光束，无镜头；非物影成像的遮挡影，非化学成像渍斑，非玻璃刻画转印，亦非日晒植物褪色印。

description_en: Boro: Japanese mended-cloth method as the image—irregular indigo patches, visible running-stitch repairs, frayed joins and leftover scraps; not sashiko as a regular geometric grid, not kantha narrative quilting, not kasuri ikat blur, not shibori tie-resist circles.
description_zh: 襤褸：以日本缝补布为画面方法，不规则靛蓝补丁、明露的跑针缝补、毛边拼缝与余布；非规则几何的刺子绣网格，非坎塔叙事绗缝，非絣织晕纹，亦非绞缬圆环。

description_en: Hakeme: coarse slip-brushing on stoneware as the image method—white slip dragged in fanned hakeme strokes, clay body showing in skips, brush-hair tracks after firing; not mishima inlaid slip, not kohiki overall white dip, not sgraffito scratched through slip, not oribe green glaze.
description_zh: 刷毛目：以粗刷白化妆土入画，扇形刷痕、露胎跳笔、烧成后的刷毛轨迹；非三岛镶嵌化妆土，非粉引通体蘸白，非刮刻灰泥，亦非织部绿釉。

description_en: Reticello: Venetian vetro a reticello as the image method—criss-cross white cane lattice trapped in clear glass, a tiny air bubble in each diamond; not millefiori murrine flowers, not zanfirico twisted ribbons alone, not sommerso color casing, not stained-glass leading.
description_zh: 网纹玻璃：以威尼斯网纹玻璃入画，透明玻璃中交叉白料格子、每格一粒气泡；非千花马赛克玻璃，非单独的扭枝玻璃丝，非浸泡套色，亦非镶铅彩窗。

description_en: Crystoleum: Victorian glass-bound hand-colored photograph as the image method—photographic drawing adhered face-down to glass, reverse-painted in translucent oils so color blooms through; not ivorytype, not opalotype white-glass photo, not autochrome starch-grain color, not oil-print pigment on paper.
description_zh: 水晶油彩照片：以维多利亚水晶油彩照片入画，影像贴合玻璃背面再以半透明油彩反画，色从影像中透出；非象牙型照片，非乳白玻璃照片，非奥托克罗姆淀粉颗粒彩，亦非纸本油彩印。

description_en: Floating-silk Line: gaogu yousi miao as the image method—even, hair-thin continuous contours like gossamer silk, no swell or taper; not iron-wire drawing, not orchid-leaf modulated stroke, not nail-head rat-tail, not gongbi dense texture, not xieyi splash.
description_zh: 高古游丝描：以均匀细如游丝的连续轮廓入画，无提按粗细；非铁线描，非兰叶描起伏，非钉头鼠尾描，非工笔密皴，亦非写意泼墨。

description_en: Negoro: vermilion urushi over black lacquer, worn-through red revealing black at edges and high points; not maki-e gold powder, not carved tsuishu/tihong, not raden shell, not chinkin engraving.
description_zh: 根来涂：朱漆覆黑漆，边缘与高处磨损露黑；非莳绘金粉，非堆朱剔红浮雕，非螺钿，亦非沉金阴刻。

description_en: Kohiki: thin milky-white slip over dark iron clay, crawling, pinholes, toasted clay at rims; not hakeme brush-stripe slip, not mishima inlay, not celadon glaze, not raku crackle.
description_zh: 粉引：乳白薄化妆土覆铁质胎土，缩釉针孔与口沿露胎；非刷毛目条纹，非三岛嵌，非青瓷釉，亦非乐烧开片。

description_en: Patola: Gujarati double-ikat silk, warp and weft resist-dyed before weaving, stepped geometric lozenges, identical reverse; not single ikat, not kasuri, not bandhani dots, not batik wax, not palampore chintz.
description_zh: 帕托拉：古吉拉特双经纬絣，织前经纬皆防染，几何菱格与阶梯接色、正反同纹；非单絣，非絣织，非班达尼点扎，非蜡染裂纹，亦非帕兰波尔手绘。

description_en: Nabeshima: milky porcelain with Iro-Nabeshima overglaze iron-red, celadon-green, yellow plus underglaze cobalt, sparse exquisite fields and brocade borders; not crowded Imari export, not Kakiemon empty-ground, not Kutani gold-heavy.
description_zh: 锅岛烧：乳白瓷上色锅岛赤绿黄釉上彩与釉下钴蓝，疏朗构图与织锦边饰；非伊万里满密外销，非柿右卫门留白，亦非九谷堆金。

description_en: Orchid-leaf Line: lanye miao as the image method—brush contours that swell and taper like orchid blades; not even-width floating-silk line, not iron-wire drawing, not nail-head rat-tail, not gongbi fill, not xieyi splash.
description_zh: 兰叶描：以提按如兰叶的起伏轮廓入画；非高古游丝描等宽细线，非铁线描，非钉头鼠尾描，非工笔填色，亦非写意泼墨。

description_en: Color intaglio inking: several oil hues wiped onto one copper plate with small daubers so they meet in a single impression, with plate-tone and a pressed plate mark.
description_zh: 用小布头将多种油墨分别擦入同一块凹版，一次压印完成多色交融，带有版垢与压痕。

description_en: Impressionist handling that lays unblended complementary strokes side by side so the eye, not the brush, mixes the hue.
description_zh: 印象派将互补色笔触并置而不调和，由观者眼睛完成光学混色。

description_en: Analog manga production: cut adhesive halftone sheets burnished over G-pen ink contours on drawing paper.
description_zh: 在墨线稿上剪贴并磨压网点胶纸的模拟漫画制版法。

description_en: Split-fountain printmaking that blends inks on one brayer into a continuous spectrum band across the print.
description_zh: 在同一墨辊上混合多色，印出连续光谱过渡的分色辊技法。

description_en: Classic black-and-white enlargement on fiber paper with a silver-halide gelatin emulsion, deep Dmax and fine grain.
description_zh: 以银盐明胶乳剂在钡地纸上放大的经典黑白照片工艺，深黑与细颗粒。

description_en: Classical Chinese figure contour: each stroke begins with a blunt nail-head accent and tapers to a long rat-tail point.
description_zh: 传统人物线描：起笔如钉头顿挫，收笔如鼠尾渐细的十八描之一。

description_en: Kangxi overglaze enamel on white porcelain: iron-red, copper-green, yellow, aubergine and black outlines with fired ceramic sheen.
description_zh: 康熙朝白瓷上的釉上五彩：矾红、翠绿、黄、茄皮紫与墨线，窑烧珐琅光泽。

description_en: Malay-Indonesian supplementary-weft brocade: extra gold and silver metallic threads woven into silk geometric ceremonial cloth.
description_zh: 马来—印尼织金锦：以金银辅纬在丝绸上织出几何纹样的礼仪织锦。

description_en: Japanese high-fired stoneware: coarse orange-brown body, bursting feldspar grit, natural wood-ash glaze runs and kiln scorch.
description_zh: 日本信乐窑高温炻器：橙褐粗胎、长石爆裂、自然灰釉流挂与火痕。

description_en: Taisho–Showa stencil-dyed silk: bold graphic repeats with slightly blurred warp-and-weft dye edges on mill-woven kimono cloth.
description_zh: 大正—昭和铭仙：型染丝绸上大胆图形重复，经纬渗色边缘略带模糊。

description_en: Chinese Eighteen Strokes drapery line: slender, slightly curved contours that taper at both ends like willow leaves.
description_zh: 十八描之一：纤细微曲、两端尖收如柳叶的衣纹线描。

description_en: Dehua ivory-white porcelain: unctuous translucent glaze, modeled relief, almost no polychrome, satiny kiln sheen.
description_zh: 德化白瓷：脂玉般透光釉、塑形浮雕、几乎无彩，窑烧缎面光泽。

description_en: Kyoto ceremonial brocade: supplementary-weft gold and colored silk, dense karakusa and geometric repeats, woven not printed.
description_zh: 京都西阵织金锦：金银与彩丝辅纬、唐草与几何密纹，织成而非印染。

description_en: Lithographic tusche on stone: greasy black wash, reticulated drying edges, crayon scumble and spatter on print paper.
description_zh: 石版药墨：油脂黑渲染、干边网裂、蜡笔擦涂与飞溅于印纸。

description_en: Attic red-figure vase painting: reserved orange clay figures, glossy black slip ground, inner details in dilute relief line.
description_zh: 阿提卡红绘陶：留出橙红陶土人物、黑亮泥釉底，淡釉浮雕线刻画细节。

description_en: Attic black-figure vase painting: glossy black-slip silhouettes on reserved orange clay, inner details incised through the slip, spare added white and red.
description_zh: 阿提卡黑绘陶：橙红陶土底上以黑亮泥釉剪影造型，针刻划出内部细节，点缀少量白与暗红。

description_en: Chinese Eighteen Strokes drapery line: firm angular contours that kink and taper like snapped reed leaves, thick-to-thin turns without soft willow curves.
description_zh: 十八描之一：衣纹以刚折顿挫的笔线写出，如折断芦叶，粗细急转而不取柔曲柳叶势。

description_en: Carved rhinoceros-skin lacquer: stacked black, cinnabar, and ochre layers cut in scrolling pommel motifs so the bevels reveal concentric color bands.
description_zh: 剔犀漆：黑、朱红与赭色多层相叠，以云剑纹深剔，剖面上呈现如年轮的色带。

description_en: Satsuma ware: ivory crackled glaze densely painted with overglaze polychrome enamels and raised gold, millifleur grounds and tea-brown rims.
description_zh: 萨摩烧：牙色开片釉上密绘釉上彩与堆金，千花锦地，茶褐口沿。

description_en: Edo fine-pattern stencil dyeing: all-over micro-motifs (sharkskin, hail, tiny crests) in a single restrained color, reading almost solid from afar.
description_zh: 江户小纹：型纸染出满地微纹（鲛、霰、细纹家纹），远看近乎素色，近看满布细点。

description_en: Even-tension figure outlines like plucked zither strings: uniform-width ink, faint spring, no taper.
description_zh: 琴弦描：如绷弦般等宽劲利的衣纹线，匀而不滞，少见起收钉头。

description_en: Cao Zhongda drapery: dense parallel clinging fold-lines wrapping the figure like carved wet silk.
description_zh: 曹衣描：曹仲达衣纹，密排贴体的平行褶线，如塑如刻。

description_en: Jingdezhen underglaze cobalt on white porcelain: watery blue washes and outlines under a clear glaze.
description_zh: 青花：釉下钴料绘于白瓷，水料晕散，罩透明釉后呈幽蓝。

description_en: Low-warp pictorial wool tapestry: weft ribs, slit joins, hachure blending, floral workshop borders.
description_zh: 奥布松织锦：低经密织的毛织挂毯，纬棱与切口、影线混色、花叶边饰。

description_en: Goldtone glass positive: gelatin-silver image backed with gold leaf, gilt highlights and chocolate shadows.
description_zh: 金调正片：玻璃上的明胶银影衬金箔，高光鎏金、暗部巧克力褐。

description_en: Scorched-ink painting: bone-dry concentrated black, flying-white splits, parched dragged strokes on xuan paper.
description_zh: 焦墨：极浓近干的墨线与飞白，枯笔擦纸，少水少晕。

description_en: Attic white-ground pottery: chalky slip, outline drawing, faded ochre and dilute glaze on a ceramic vessel.
description_zh: 白地彩绘：白化妆土底、淡彩线描与剥落矿彩，异于红绘与黑绘。

description_en: Venetian filigree glass: latticino and zanfirico canes trapped in clear soda glass, not reticello net.
description_zh: 玻璃丝绵：穆拉诺灯芯与扭枝色线嵌于透明玻璃，非网纹玻璃。

description_en: Light-crimson landscape: ink structure with pale ochre and diluted crimson washes, literati restraint.
description_zh: 浅绛：水墨立骨，浅赭与淡绛罩染，色不压墨。

description_en: Jizhou ware: paper-cut and leaf-resist silhouettes in dark iron glaze, tortoiseshell mottling.
description_zh: 吉州窑：剪纸与木叶贴花、玳瑁斑与黑褐釉，异于建盏天目。

description_en: Brown-monochrome oil: umber and sienna glazes only, warm imprimatura, no gray grisaille and no full chroma.
description_zh: 棕单色油画：仅用赭褐釉染与暖色底，异于灰色单色与全彩。

description_en: Water-gilded gold leaf over red bole on gesso: burnish, punchwork, and bole showing at cracks.
description_zh: 水贴金：红土打底贴金箔，抛光与錾点，裂纹露出土红。

description_en: Slit-tapestry flatweave: weft-faced wool, vertical slits, stepped lozenges and latch-hook geometry.
description_zh: 基里姆：开口织平织毯，纬面毛线、竖向开缝与阶梯菱纹。

description_en: Photocopy art: high-contrast toner grain, generation loss, copier streaks and electrostatic scatter.
description_zh: 静电复印艺术：高反差碳粉颗粒、代际损耗、复印条纹与静电散点。

description_en: Fine Hellenistic mosaic: tiny tesserae in worm-like contour andamento wrapping the form.
description_zh: 蠕虫镶嵌：细小马赛克沿轮廓作蠕虫状走向，异于粗块镶嵌。

description_en: Classical Chinese drapery method: short tapered ink strokes clustered like bamboo leaflets.
description_zh: 竹叶描：短促尖收的衣纹笔，聚簇如竹叶，有别于长弧柳叶描。

description_en: Northern Song carved celadon: olive glaze pooling in incised peony and combing.
description_zh: 耀州窑：橄榄绿透明釉积于刻花与篦纹，有别于龙泉青瓷与天目。

description_en: Gobelins pictorial tapestry: wool-silk weft, warp rib, color mixed by hatchure.
description_zh: 戈布兰织锦：经棱可见，以色线排丝混色，有别于奥布松织锦。

description_en: Photosynthesis print on a living leaf: UV-bleached chlorophyll forms the image in pale tissue.
description_zh: 叶绿素印相：以叶片为感光层，紫外漂白叶绿素成像，叶脉仍可见。

description_en: Roman cut-stone inlay of large marble and porphyry slabs fitted edge to edge.
description_zh: 板块镶嵌：大切石板拼合，石纹可见，有别于细粒蠕虫镶嵌与硬石镶嵌。

description_en: Green monochrome oil: terre-verte, viridian glazes, and mint highlights with no independent other hues.
description_zh: 绿单色：全幅以土绿、翠绿釉与薄荷高光造型，有别于灰色单色与棕单色。

description_en: Ultrafine burnished clay slip: satin red-orange ceramic skin without thick glaze pooling.
description_zh: 磨光泥釉：超细陶衣抛光呈缎面红赭，有别于厚釉开片与天目。

description_en: Renaissance pouncing: pricked cartoon, charcoal-sinopia dots transferred onto lime plaster.
description_zh: 粉本透稿：刺孔粉本以木炭与红土粉点转到湿壁画底，有别于铁线描与银尖素描。

description_en: Goldsmith granulation: thousands of fused gold spheres forming form, not drawn wire filigree.
description_zh: 金粒细工：细金珠熔接成纹与形体，有别于金银丝细工与景泰蓝。

description_en: Boulle marquetry: brass and tortoiseshell veneer arabesques on ebony, première-partie inlay.
description_zh: 布尔镶嵌：黄铜与玳瑁薄片对花嵌于乌木，有别于嵌木与硬石镶嵌。

description_en: Reverse-glass painting: pigments and gold leaf laid on the back of glass in reverse order, viewed through the pane.
description_zh: 玻璃背彩：颜料与金箔按反向层次画于玻璃背面，从正面透过玻璃观看。

description_en: Goryeo sanggam: black and white slip inlaid into carved clay, sealed under translucent celadon glaze.
description_zh: 高丽镶嵌青瓷：黑白化妆土嵌入刻纹，再罩透青釉。

description_en: Sunago: gold dust sprinkled through a bamboo tube onto wet lacquer or sized paper, form built by scatter density.
description_zh: 砂子金：金粉经竹筒洒落于湿漆或上胶纸面，以疏密构成形象。

description_en: Fedoskino lacquer miniature: oil glazes over papier-mâché lacquer, often with mother-of-pearl under-shimmer.
description_zh: 费多谢基诺漆画：纸胎漆地上以油画罩染，常衬珍珠母闪光。

description_en: Trapunto: Italian stuffed quilting, stitched outlines padded from behind into high-relief cloth volume.
description_zh: 浮雕绗缝：意大利填充绗缝，线描轮廓自背面填絮形成高浮雕布面。

description_en: Platinum print: platinotype salts in paper fibers, velvety warm-gray scale, matte paper tooth, no glossy color.
description_zh: 铂金印相：铂盐渗入纸基，丝绒暖灰长阶调，哑光纸纹，无光泽彩喷感。

description_en: Neriage: wheel-thrown mixed colored clays, helical agateware striations from throwing, not loaf-sliced nerikomi.
description_zh: 练上：色泥混练拉坯，螺旋绞胎条纹随轮转展开，有别于切片贴合的练込。

description_en: Anaglyph: red-cyan stereo pair, horizontal parallax fringe and channel ghosting, grayscale scene through complementary filters.
description_zh: 红青立体：红青双通道立体对，水平视差色边与串影，灰阶场景经互补滤镜编码。

description_en: Shakudō: copper-gold alloy with raven niiro patina, gold-silver hira-zōgan inlay, hammered metal grain.
description_zh: 赤铜：铜金合金经煮色呈鸦黑紫光，平象嵌金银线，锤痕金属肌理。

description_en: Punchwork: tooled gold-leaf ground, punched dots rings and rosettes, bole-red wear, burnished medieval panel.
description_zh: 錾点金地：金箔地錾点圆环与蔷薇纹，丹坨红底微露，中世纪贴金屏面。

description_en: Korean gold-foil fusion on darkened silver; raised 24k overlays, oxidized sterling ground.
description_zh: 韩国金箔熔附于氧化银地，浮起金纹、炭黑银底。

description_en: Cloth-grain metal inlay: nunome tooth chased into iron, gold and silver hammered into the mesh.
description_zh: 布目齿纹錾入铁地，金银锤入织物齿中。

description_en: Copper-red kiln-change glaze: oxblood, strawberry, and violet-blue rivers pooling on porcelain.
description_zh: 铜红窑变釉，牛血红、草莓与紫蓝流釉汇积。

description_en: Carved persimmon-tanned mulberry stencil paper; lace-like knife cuts and ito-ire silk grid.
description_zh: 柿渋和纸型纸，细刀镂空与丝线加固网格。

description_en: Maruyama boneless wash: wet-into-wet volumetric ink with no contour outlines.
description_zh: 圆山派付立描，没骨湿墨塑形，不见勾勒。

description_en: Early ukiyo-e hand-color: sumizuri key-block on washi, tan (red-lead vermilion) brushed as the sole pigment.
description_zh: 早期浮世绘手彩，墨摺主版于和纸，仅刷丹铅朱红。

description_en: Deccan zinc-alloy inlay: shahad-blackened ground, silver vines and butis hammered flush and burnished.
description_zh: 德干锌合金嵌银，沙哈德黑地，银蔓与布提锤平抛光。

description_en: Rajasthani wave tie-dye: diagonal leher ripples in turmeric, fuchsia, emerald, and indigo with resist bleed.
description_zh: 拉贾斯坦波浪扎染，姜黄、品红、翠绿与靛蓝斜纹，防染渗边。

description_en: Interference-color photography on a mercury-backed glass plate; spectral opalescent hues without pigment dyes.
description_zh: 汞背玻璃干涉彩照，无染料的光谱乳光色。

description_en: White-on-white eyelet embroidery: satin-stitched rings around punched holes, trailing floral cutwork on muslin.
description_zh: 白地白绣镂空，缎针锁眼、花卉镂刻于细棉布。

description_en: Early ukiyo-e finished with glossy black lacquer: wet sheen over flat printed color, jet pools, limited Edo palette.
description_zh: 早期浮世绘上罩亮漆：湿润高光覆于平色木版、漆黑积淀、江户限定色。

description_en: Dhaka figured muslin: sheer cotton ground with discontinuous extra-weft butis that float in the weave.
description_zh: 达卡提花细棉：薄透地组织上以断续辅纬织出浮于布面的碎花纹。

description_en: Vienna mixed technique: egg-tempera lights over warm imprimatura, then thin luminous oil glazes.
description_zh: 维也纳混合技法：暖色底上蛋彩提亮，再以多层薄油罩染发出釉光。

description_en: Gold-brocade overglaze porcelain: iron-red or cobalt ground with fired gilt arabesques on glassy enamel.
description_zh: 金襴手彩瓷：矾红或钴蓝地上以烤金卷草与锦地纹覆于玻璃质釉面。

description_en: Varnished chromolithograph on canvas weave: lithographic stipple under yellowed copal, aniline period color.
description_zh: 上光石印仿油画：帆布纹上可见网点与蜡笔粒、发黄珂巴尔清漆、苯胺期色彩。

description_en: Japanese slanted-chisel engraving: tapering triangular cuts mimic brush strokes on dark patinated metal.
description_zh: 日本片切彫：斜凿三角刀痕在暗色铜铁上摹仿墨笔收锋。

description_en: Split-silk needle painting: directional satin stitches blend tones on cream ground with filament sheen.
description_zh: 劈丝仿真绣：套针顺势晕色，丝光浮于米白缎地。

description_en: Mexican tin-glazed earthenware: cobalt, antimony yellow, copper green and manganese on craquelure white glaze.
description_zh: 墨西哥锡釉彩陶：钴蓝、锑黄、铜绿与锰紫绘于开片白釉。

description_en: Russian Gorodets panel painting: opaque aniline reds and yellows, black outline, kupavka roses on varnished wood.
description_zh: 俄罗斯戈罗杰茨板绘：不透明苯胺红黄、黑线勾勒、木上库帕夫卡玫瑰。

description_en: Early additive color plate: ruled RGB viewing screen over a panchromatic glass transparency.
description_zh: 早期加色法彩屏：红绿蓝线屏覆于全色玻璃正片。

description_en: Wajima lacquer: jinoko clay ground, layered urushi, roiro black polish, vermillion and gold on a wet-looking panel.
description_zh: 轮岛涂：地之粉胎、多层生漆、吕色黑推光，朱漆与金粉浮于镜面漆地。

description_en: Backlit biscuit porcelain: the image forms only from thickness, thin areas glowing warm, thick areas staying opaque grey.
description_zh: 透光浮雕瓷：素烧瓷板以厚薄成像，薄处暖光透出、厚处灰白不透明。

description_en: Roman micromosaic: thousands of tiny smalti and filati tesserae, visible grout, glass-rod pixels of a Vatican workshop plaque.
description_zh: 罗马微马赛克：细玻璃丝与马赛克粒密铺，灰缝可见，梵蒂冈工坊嵌画质感。

description_en: Manises tin-glaze lusterware: creamy opacified glaze, cobalt drawing, copper-gold metallic flash, vine arabesques, craquelure.
description_zh: 马尼塞斯锡釉虹彩陶：乳白锡釉、钴蓝勾描、铜金虹彩、卷草与开片。

description_en: Tambour-hook embroidery on tulle: chain stitch, seed beads, sequins and couched metal thread with net ground showing through.
description_zh: 吕内维尔绷圈绣：钩针链缝于薄纱，米珠、亮片与金银线，网地透出。

description_en: Aomori lacquer: many colored urushi layers sanded through into mottled kara-nuri and nanako speckles, then polished to wet-mirror gloss.
description_zh: 青森津轻涂：多层彩漆研磨透出唐涂与鱼子斑点，再抛成镜面漆光。

description_en: Weft-wrapping tapestry: oblique wrapped wefts form herringbone ridges, stepped color blocks, and a ridged woven surface rather than knotted pile.
description_zh: 苏马克织：纬线斜向缠绕成人字棱脊与阶梯色块，织面起棱而非打结绒头。

description_en: Staffordshire underglaze transfer print: cobalt engraved copperplate lines and stipple on white glazed earthenware, with scroll-and-flower borders.
description_zh: 斯塔福德郡釉下转印：钴蓝铜版线刻与点刻印上白釉陶，卷草花卉边饰。

description_en: Italian counted-thread: motif left void on linen, background filled in red cross-stitch, motif edged with Holbein outline.
description_zh: 意大利阿西西计数绣：图案留白于亚麻，地子以红色十字绣填满，黑线勾边。

description_en: Minoan polychrome pottery: creamy white, crimson and ochre-yellow whirling motifs on glossy black slip, marine-style curves on eggshell ware.
description_zh: 米诺斯卡马雷斯陶：乳白、朱红与赭黄涡纹绘于亮黑陶衣，海洋风曲线薄胎。

description_en: Indian gold-and-silver wire inlay on darkened blued steel: hammered gold arabesques set flush into burnished metal.
description_zh: 印度嵌金钢饰：金银丝锤嵌入发蓝暗钢，阿拉伯卷草与钢面齐平。

description_en: Ilkhanid overglaze: deep lapis-lazuli cobalt ground painted in gold, red and white enamel with raised gold leaf.
description_zh: 伊尔汗青金石釉：深蓝钴地上金、红、白釉上彩与贴金。

description_en: Etruscan reduction-fired burnished black ceramic: glossy charcoal surface with incised line and low relief.
description_zh: 伊特鲁里亚布凯罗黑陶：还原烧磨光炭黑，阴刻线与浅浮雕。

description_en: Carved multilayer cinnabar-and-black urushi: V-groove spirals that expose concentric red-black rings.
description_zh: 屈轮漆：朱红与黑漆多层堆叠，V形槽卷云露出同心色环。

description_en: Japanese carved wood coated in vermilion and black lacquer; worn highs reveal black under cinnabar red.
description_zh: 镰仓雕：木胎阴刻再罩朱红与黑漆，高点磨损露出底层黑漆。

description_en: Japanese irogane copper-silver alloy with muted grey-green patina, burnished pewter highlights, and faint gold flecks.
description_zh: 日本四分一铜银合金：灰绿锈色、锡灰高光与细金点。

description_en: Ryukyuan colored-lacquer paste built in low relief on black urushi, then carved and polished into stacked pigment pads.
description_zh: 琉球堆锦：黑漆地上堆起彩漆膏，再雕磨成层叠色块。

description_en: Song bluish-white porcelain: thin ice-water glaze pooling in carved-slip recesses over a warm white body.
description_zh: 宋代青白瓷：薄釉呈冰水色，积于刻花凹处，胎色暖白。

description_en: Murano submerged glass: a saturated color core encased in thick clear cristallo with refractive edges.
description_zh: 穆拉诺套色玻璃：饱和色芯裹入厚透明水晶，边缘强折射。

description_en: Orrefors Graal overlay: interior color cut and engraved, then cased in clear crystal so the drawing sits under glass.
description_zh: 奥勒福斯格拉尔：内层彩色刻绘后再套透明水晶，图像藏于玻璃下。

description_en: Venetian incalmo: two separately blown gathers fused at a clean equatorial join so stacked color casings read as one vessel.
description_zh: 威尼斯拼接吹制：两坨分色吹制玻璃在赤道接缝熔合，套色层读成一件器。

description_en: Eggshell lacquer: crushed shell tesserae inlaid in black urushi, crackle mosaic with gold in the interstices.
description_zh: 蛋壳漆：碎蛋壳嵌黑漆，裂纹马赛克，缝间洒金。

description_en: Burnout velvet: chemical-eaten pile leaves sheer ground against remaining plush, so drawing is pile versus gauze.
description_zh: 烂花绒：药剂蚀去绒毛留下薄纱地与残绒，以绒与纱作画。

description_en: Nanjing cloud brocade: gold and polychrome wefts woven into satin, cloud-and-lotus patterns sitting in the cloth not on it.
description_zh: 南京云锦：金线与彩纬织入缎地，云莲纹在布里而非布上。

description_en: Qing falangcai: gem-like overglaze enamels on milk-white porcelain reserve, court-workshop enamel painting on the ware.
description_zh: 清珐琅彩：宝石质釉上彩绘于奶白瓷地，宫廷作坊珐琅画瓷。

description_en: Venetian battuto: cold-worked hammered glass, dense irregular chisel facets catching raking light through a translucent body.
description_zh: 威尼斯锤纹玻璃：冷加工锤面，密集不规则凿面在透光玻璃体上折光。

description_en: Zinc-silicate crystalline glaze: radiating starburst and fan crystals in a high-fire glossy ground with kiln-flow drips.
description_zh: 结晶釉：锌硅酸盐放射星晶与扇晶生于高温亮釉地，窑流垂釉。

description_en: Bobbin lace: continuous-thread pillow lace, cloth-stitch and half-stitch grounds, open reseau, raised gimp outlines.
description_zh: 线轴蕾丝：枕上连续线织，布纹针与半针地网、透空网眼、加粗轮廓线。

description_en: Lost-wax bronze: wax-tool modeling cast in metal, patina in recesses, chasing marks and investment grain.
description_zh: 失蜡青铜：蜡塑痕迹转入金属，凹处包浆、錾刻与铸型砂粒。

description_en: Pen and wash: waterproof ink contour and hatch with transparent watercolor washes on cold-press paper.
description_zh: 钢笔淡彩：防水墨线勾勒排线，再罩透明水彩于冷压纸面。

description_en: Punto in aria: needle lace with no fabric ground — buttonhole stitch, cordonnet, picots and open reseau in air-stitched thread.
description_zh: 空中针绣：无布底的针绣蕾丝，锁绣针、加粗轮廓线、皮柯与透空地网悬于线间。

description_en: Zanfirico: Venetian twisted filigree canes — lattimo and aventurine spirals fused inside clear cristallo.
description_zh: 扭转玻璃条：威尼斯扭转费利格里玻璃棒，乳白与金星螺旋熔于无色水晶玻璃中。

description_en: Goldpoint: gold metalpoint on prepared gesso ground, fine hatch, warm tarnished gold-brown line, reserved paper as light.
description_zh: 金尖素描：金质金属尖于石膏底，细密排线，暖金褐氧化笔迹，留白为光。

description_en: Aeropittura: Futurist aerial painting — overlapping flight viewpoints, force-lines, propeller arcs and simultaneous landscape fragments.
description_zh: 航空绘画：未来主义空中视点叠合，力线、螺旋桨弧与同时性风景碎片。

description_en: Drip painting: enamel and alkyd flung and pooled on raw canvas — skeins, splatters, gravity runs, no brush modeling.
description_zh: 滴洒绘画：瓷漆与醇酸颜料甩泼于生画布，线络、飞溅与重力流淌，不以画笔塑形。

description_en: Craquelure: aged varnish and paint film splitting into an all-over island network of fine irregular cracks.
description_zh: 开裂纹饰：老化光油与色层开裂，形成遍布画面的不规则细裂纹岛网。

description_en: Itajime: board-clamp shibori — accordion folds and wooden blocks reserve hard geometric diamonds and chevrons in dye.
description_zh: 板缔：夹板绞缬，手风琴折叠与木板夹防染，留下硬边菱形与折线几何。

description_en: Faience: opaque tin-glazed earthenware, milky white ground, cobalt-manganese-copper painting, pooled glaze and fine crazing.
description_zh: 费昂斯：不透明锡釉陶，乳白地，钴紫铜绿彩绘，釉积与细开片。

description_en: Petit point: pictorial tent-stitch needlepoint on fine canvas, minute diagonal wool stitches and visible mesh.
description_zh: 小点绣：细布上的斜向小点针绣，羊毛短针与可见网眼构成整幅画面。

description_en: Drybrush: nearly dry bristle dragging scant pigment across tooth, broken skipping strokes, paper sparkle through.
description_zh: 干笔：近干鬃毛刮过纸齿，断续跳笔，底纸齿孔透出闪光。

description_en: Jianzhan: Song iron-glaze stoneware, hare's-fur streaks, oil-spot crystals, pooled black-brown glaze.
description_zh: 建盏：宋代铁釉炻器，兔毫流纹、油滴结晶、积釉黑褐。

description_en: Chūsen: poured stencil dyeing, rice-paste resist, double-sided soak, blurred dye floods on cotton.
description_zh: 注染：镂版注色染，防染糊、双面渗透、棉布上的晕色色块。

description_en: Ariel glass: cased crystal with sandblasted air-trap cavities sealed between layers, optical refraction.
description_zh: 阿里尔玻璃：套层水晶中封入喷砂气穴，内气泡与折射成像。

description_en: Mocha diffusion: acid dropped into wet slip, dendritic fern trees, colored banding on earthenware.
description_zh: 摩卡渗纹：湿化妆土上滴酸，蕨状树枝纹与色带化妆土。

description_en: Schwarzlot: fired black enamel on glass, hatching and wash like copperplate, vitreous sheen.
description_zh: 黑彩玻璃绘：玻璃上烧制黑釉彩，铜版般排线与渲染，釉面反光。

description_en: Youlihong: underglaze copper-red on porcelain, oxblood blooms and reduction greys under a wet transparent glaze.
description_zh: 釉里红：瓷上釉下铜红，牛血红晕染与还原灰斑，透明釉面润泽。

description_en: Zwischengoldglas: gold leaf engraved between fused glass layers, trapped bubbles and bevel refraction.
description_zh: 夹金玻璃：金箔夹于熔合玻璃层间刻画，气泡与斜边折光。

description_en: Salt glaze: high-fired salt-vapor stoneware, orange-peel pitting, amber flashing, and iron speckle.
description_zh: 盐釉：高温盐雾炻器，橘皮坑点、琥珀火痕与铁斑。

description_en: Mimeograph: wax-stencil duplicator print, aniline purple-blue ink, fiber bleed, and paper cockle.
description_zh: 誊写油印：蜡纸誊写油印，苯胺蓝紫墨、纤维渗墨与纸皱。

description_en: Lampwork: torch-gathered soda-lime glass, striated cane, trapped bubbles, and furnace-orange glow.
description_zh: 灯工玻璃：喷灯熔制钠钙玻璃，色棒条纹、气泡与炉火橙光。

description_en: Needle painting: silk shading in long-and-short stitch, directional floss, blended thread color, filament sheen.
description_zh: 丝线晕绣：长短针丝线晕染，顺形走线、色线交融与丝光。

description_en: Reticella: geometric needle lace of square-grid cutwork, buttonholed bars, wheels, and openwork on a dark void.
description_zh: 网眼针绣：方格抽纱、锁边撑线、轮形填充与镂空底。

description_en: Moving-cloud flowing-water line: even unmodulated ink that drifts like cloud and runs like water, pale silk ground.
description_zh: 行云流水描：均匀无顿挫的游走墨线，如云行水流，浅素绢底。

description_en: Ge ware: double crackle glaze, bold iron-wire fissures over fine golden-thread crazing on gray-beige celadon.
description_zh: 哥窑：开片釉，粗铁线叠细金丝，灰青脂光釉面。

description_en: Heliography: bitumen of Judea on pewter, asphalt lights, washed pewter shadows, 1820s proto-photograph plate.
description_zh: 日光沥青版：犹地沥青覆白镴，受光硬化、阴影冲洗，一八二〇年代原照版。

description_en: Notan: Japanese light-dark mass design as the image method—pure black against pure white interlocking silhouettes, shared edges only, no gray, no color, no hatch; not paper-cut collage, not woodcut, not stencil.
description_zh: 能探：以日本浓淡黑白块面入画，纯黑与纯白互锁剪影、共边而无灰阶无设色无排线，非剪纸拼贴，非木刻，亦非漏版。

description_en: Dichroic Glass: thin-film interference coatings as the image method—angle-shift magenta-cyan-gold, layered refractive sheets, optical iridescence; not stained-glass leadlines, not carnival glass, not favrile.
description_zh: 二向色玻璃：以薄膜干涉镀层入画，随角变色的品红-青-金、层叠折射与虹彩，非铅条彩窗，非嘉年华玻璃，亦非法夫莱虹彩。

description_en: Carpet Page: Insular manuscript full-page interlace as the image method—knotwork, trumpet-spirals, dotted contours and mineral reds-yellows-greens-blues on vellum; not a photographed book object, not later Gothic illumination, not carpet weaving.
description_zh: 地毯页：以岛屿福音书满页交缠纹样入画，结绳、喇叭涡卷、点描轮廓与矿物红黄绿青覆于犊皮，非书册静物，非后期哥特细密，亦非织毯。

description_en: Jiaxie: Tang clamp-resist dyeing as the image method—folded-board symmetric blooms, indigo with mineral red and yellow, crisp resist edges on cloth; not batik wax crackle, not shibori wrinkle-resist, not chusen pour-dye.
description_zh: 夹缬：以唐代夹板防染入画，对折对称花几何、靛蓝间矿物红黄、布面锐利防染边，非蜡染冰裂纹，非绞缬皱防，亦非注染。

description_en: Pochade: small outdoor oil color-sketch on panel as the image method—wet economical masses, portable sketch-box notes of light, visible panel at the rim; not a finished salon canvas, not plein-air photography, not impressionist pointille.
description_zh: 外光色稿：以便携画箱外光油彩小稿入画，湿润省笔色块、现场光色速记、板边木纹可见，非沙龙完成作，非外光照片，亦非点彩。

description_en: Ru Ware: Song celadon as the image method—sky-blue duck-egg glaze, sparse ice crackle, sesame-iron flecks, pooled rims; not Ge gold-crackle, not Jun splashes, not Longquan green.
description_zh: 汝窑：以天青鸭蛋青釉入画，疏冰裂纹、芝麻铁斑、口沿聚釉，非哥窑金丝开片，非钧瓷窑变，亦非龙泉梅子青。

description_en: Copperpoint: oxidized copper stylus on prepared cream ground—fine reddish-brown tarnish hatch, paper tooth, no graphite shine, not silverpoint gray, not sanguine chalk.
description_zh: 铜尖素描：以氧化铜尖在涂粉底上入画，红褐铜锈细线、纸齿可见，无石墨反光，非银尖冷灰，亦非红粉笔。

description_en: Aventurine glass: copper spangles frozen in amber-ruby glass mass—internal glitter fire, thick refraction; not dichroic coating, not millefiori canes, not sommerso blocks.
description_zh: 金星玻璃：以铜晶金星悬浮于琥珀红玻璃体入画，内闪火光、厚折射，非二向色镀膜，非千花玻璃棒，亦非套色块。

description_en: Hectograph: aniline-purple gelatin duplicator transfer—damp bloom, mauve-violet limited dye, cockled paper, ghosted impression; not mimeograph oil stencil, not risograph, not xerox.
description_zh: 胶版誊写：以苯胺紫明胶誊写入画，湿晕、紫褐限色、纸皱与重影，非油印蜡纸，非孔版印刷，亦非静电复印。

description_en: Geringsing: Balinese double-ikat as the image method—warp and weft resist, shivering motif edges, rust-cream-brown ritual geometry; not Gujarati patola brights, not kasuri indigo, not single-ikat warp blur only.
description_zh: 格陵辛：以巴厘双经纬扎染织入画，经纬皆防染、纹样边缘微颤、锈红乳白深褐几何，非帕托拉宝石色，非絣织靛蓝，亦非单经扎染。

description_en: Qianjiang cai: late-Qing literati overglaze as the image method—tea-stain browns, diluted ink-sepia, faint copper-red and celadon on creamy porcelain, dry-brush calligraphy tooth; not famille-rose pinks, not wucai enamel clutter, not gongbi mineral density.
description_zh: 浅绛彩：以晚清文人浅绛釉上彩入画，茶褐淡墨、微铜红与青白瓷地、干笔书法齿痕，非粉彩粉红，非五彩堆釉，亦非工笔重彩。

description_en: Oshi-e: padded silk relief as the image method—stuffed brocade shapes, stitched edges, textile weave, raking-light fabric volume, gold-thread outlines; not kirigami paper-cut, not flat embroidery, not quilt blocks.
description_zh: 押绘：以填棉丝绸浮雕入画，锦缎填絮、缝缘织纹、侧光体积与金线勾边，非剪纸，非平面刺绣，亦非拼布块面。

description_en: Flashed glass: thin colored overlay fused on clear crystal, then wheel-cut and acid-etched through the flash—ruby or cobalt skin, beveled optical depth, cameo steps; not leaded stained glass, not millefiori canes, not dichroic coating.
description_zh: 套料玻璃：以薄色料覆于水晶再轮刻酸蚀露出透明层，宝石红或钴蓝皮、斜面光学深度与浮雕台阶，非铅条彩窗，非千花玻璃，亦非二向色镀膜。

description_en: Yakishime: high-fired unglazed stoneware as the image method—vitrified clay body, wood-ash deposits, fire-flash orange and charcoal, kiln scars, no glaze pools; not raku crackle, not tenmoku iron glaze, not porcelain celadon.
description_zh: 烧締：以高温无釉炻器入画，烧结土胎、自然灰落、火色橙褐与窑疤，无釉塘，非乐烧开片，非天目铁釉，亦非青瓷。

description_en: Ginbari: silver-foil enamel as the image method—crinkled silver leaf under translucent colored enamel, foil sparkle through vitreous gloss; not cloisonné wire cells, not champlevé pits, not plique-à-jour openwork.
description_zh: 银张七宝：以皱银箔衬于透明珐琅入画，箔光透过玻璃质色釉闪烁，非掐丝景泰蓝格，非錾胎凹槽，亦非透光珐琅镂空。

description_en: Ding ware: ivory-white Song porcelain as the image method—creamy feldspathic glaze, carved and incised lotus under the skin, teardrop glaze runs, unglazed metal-bound rim; not celadon green, not Dehua blanc-de-chine, not famille-rose enamel.
description_zh: 定窑：以牙白定瓷入画，乳浊长石釉、釉下刻划莲纹、泪痕垂釉与芒口包边，非青瓷绿，非德化白，亦非粉彩釉上。

description_en: Guan ware: Southern Song official celadon as the image method—thick gray-blue glaze, gold-thread and iron-wire crackle, dark iron body at rim and foot, fat ice-crackle web; not Ge-ware black-gold crackle only, not Ru-ware sky-blue, not Longquan green pools.
description_zh: 官窑：以南宋官窑青瓷入画，厚灰蓝釉、金丝铁线开片、口足铁骨与肥釉冰裂，非哥窑金丝铁线独用，非汝窑天青，亦非龙泉翠塘。

description_en: Murrine: fused mosaic cane slices as the image method—cross-section glass murrina tiles, concentric cane eyes, optical glass seams, Murano murrine sheet; not millefiori flower paperweights, not leaded stained glass, not ceramic tesserae.
description_zh: 穆林玻璃：以玻璃棒切片熔接马赛克入画，同心穆林眼、光学接缝与穆拉诺切片铺面，非千花镇纸，非铅条彩窗，亦非陶片镶嵌。

description_en: Slipware: trailed and combed liquid clay as the image method—cream slip on red earthenware, feathered marbling, slip-trailing dots and loops, sgraffito through slip to terracotta body; not underglaze-blue porcelain, not raku, not plaster sgraffito.
description_zh: 化妆土陶：以沥粉梳羽化妆土入画，红陶地乳白化妆土、羽毛大理石纹、点线沥粉与刮露胎，非青花瓷，非乐烧，亦非灰泥刮刻。

description_en: Shisha embroidery: couched mirror work as the image method—circular shisha discs in buttonhole and herringbone, satin-stitch petals, abhla Bharat glitter on woven ground; not sequins, not beadwork only, not stained glass.
description_zh: 镜绣：以包缝镜片入画，圆镜锁针与人字针、缎绣花瓣、阿布拉镜绣织地反光，非亮片，非纯珠绣，亦非彩绘玻璃。

description_en: Print Gocco: thermal-screen pad printing as the image method—opaque flash-dry spot inks stamped through a heat-burned stencil, foam-pad impression, slight layer misregistration, creamy paper show-through; not risograph grain, not mimeograph purple, not silkscreen mesh.
description_zh: 哥科孔版：以热敏孔版垫印入画，不透明快干专色透过烙孔版垫压、轻微套印错位与奶油纸露底，非孔版印刷颗粒，非誊写油印紫，亦非丝网网纹。

description_en: Scherenschnitte: German scissor-cut silhouette as the image method—single black paper sheet, knife-and-scissors openwork, white ground through the voids, paper-thin edge shadow; not colorful Polish wycinanki, not multi-color Chinese papercut, not inked silhouette painting.
description_zh: 黑影剪纸：以德式剪刀剪影入画，单张黑纸镂空、刀剪开光、白地透空与薄纸边影，非波兰彩纸维齐南基，非多色中国剪纸，亦非墨绘剪影。

description_en: Parquetry: geometric wood-veneer tessellation as the image method—herringbone, diamonds, tumbling cubes, bookmatched grain, knife-cut veneer seams; not pictorial marquetry, not intarsia puzzle figures, not straw marquetry.
description_zh: 几何木拼：以几何木皮拼花入画，人字、菱形、立方错视与对纹木纹、刀切接缝，非图画细木镶嵌，非嵌木拼图，亦非麦秆镶嵌。

description_en: Doro-e: Edo opaque mud painting as the image method—thick mineral pigments mixed like mud, matte chalky body color, limited earthy-bright opaque palette, crusty pigment ridges, no woodblock key-line; not ukiyo-e, not nihonga mineral wash, not western gouache.
description_zh: 泥绘：以江户泥绘入画，矿物颜料调如泥浆、哑光粉质体色、有限土亮不透明色与结壳笔脊，无版画主线，非浮世绘，非日本画矿彩渲染，亦非西方水粉。

description_en: Eco print: botanical contact steam print as the image method—leaves and flowers bundled and steamed against cloth, tannin ghost silhouettes, rusty iron-mordant halos, leaf-vein impressions; not inked nature printing, not cyanotype, not anthotype.
description_zh: 植物蒸印：以植物接触蒸印入画，叶花捆蒸于布、单宁残影、铁锈媒染晕与叶脉压痕，非着墨自然印花，非蓝晒，亦非花汁日晒印。

description_en: Nail-free hinoki lattice joinery: asanoha, shippō, and kikkō openwork screens.
description_zh: 无钉桧木组子细工：麻叶、七宝与龟甲透雕格心。

description_en: Jaipur vitreous enamel fused in gold and silver cells, jewel-tone paisley fills.
description_zh: 斋浦尔金银凹槽熔珐琅，宝石色佩斯利填彩。

description_en: Watercolor miniature on fanned gilt page edges of a leather-bound book.
description_zh: 翻开烫金书口上的水彩细密画，隐于纸叠边缘。

description_en: Oxidized persimmon-tannin dye on washi and hemp, rusty brown layered stains.
description_zh: 柿涩氧化染于和纸与麻布，锈褐层叠渍色。

description_en: Persian micro-inlay of wood, bone, and brass triangles in star tessellation.
description_zh: 波斯细木骨铜三角微镶，星形密铺几何。

description_en: Twisted-wire openwork in gold and silver, scrolling volutes and soldered joins.
description_zh: 金银花丝镂空，扭丝卷草与焊点衔接。

description_en: Venini-type fused patchwork glass: irregular saturated tesserae with visible melt seams.
description_zh: 威尼斯拼色熔接玻璃，不规则饱和色块与熔缝。

description_en: Chinese figure stroke thin at both ends and swollen in the middle like a jujube pit.
description_zh: 两端细中段粗如枣核的古典人物线描。

description_en: Shuttle-lace rings, chains, and picots knotted into airy cream threadwork.
description_zh: 梭结蕾丝的环、链与齿边，米白线结镂空。

description_en: Wireless cloisonné enamel: glassy color pools with no metal cloisons, fire-polished flux.
description_zh: 无线七宝珐琅，无金属隔丝的玻璃质融色与火抛光。

description_en: Japanese cut glass: geometric facets in cased crystal, hemp-leaf and diamond kiriko cuts, prismatic refraction.
description_zh: 江户切子玻璃，套色水晶上的几何切面、麻叶与菱形纹及棱镜折射。

description_en: Hunan silk embroidery: hair-fine stitches, form-following silk sheen, dense satin and seed stitch realism.
description_zh: 湘绣丝线，发丝般细针、随形丝光与密实缎针掺针写实。

description_en: Murano pulegoso: dense trapped air bubbles in thick translucent glass, frothy furnace-blown texture.
description_zh: 穆拉诺气泡玻璃，厚壁半透明玻璃中密布气孔的熔炉起泡质感。

description_en: Ozobrome pigment process: carbon-pigment transfer, velvety blacks, gelatin relief, pictorialist print.
description_zh: 奥佐溴印色素转印，丝绒黑、明胶浮雕与画意摄影质感。

description_en: Filet lace / darned net: square knotted mesh ground with open grid versus dense darning fills.
description_zh: 网绣方网，打结网地上疏网与密实织补填充的对比。
